paper.title: Efficient Safety Alignment of Language Models via Latent Personality Traits
paper.abstract: Current safety methods for large language models are known to be vulnerable to adversarial attacks, motivating research into robust alternatives. Latent Adversarial Training (LAT) is among the most effective defenses, but can degrade utility and requires training on large datasets of harmful prompts. We introduce Latent Personality Alignment (LPA), which replaces explicit harm refusal with adversarial training on just 66 harm-agnostic statements drawn from psychometric personality literature. We

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是安全后训练里的一个老问题：怎样在不大量依赖 harmful prompt 数据、也尽量不伤害通用能力的前提下，提高模型对 jailbreak 的鲁棒性。作者针对现有 LAT（latent adversarial training）路线的两个痛点下手：一是训练通常需要成千上万条显式有害样本，数据和算力成本高；二是容易对特定 harm distribution 过拟合，同时牺牲正常任务效用。论文提出的核心问题因此不是“如何再做一个 refusal tuning”，而是：能不能用极小规模、与 harm 无直接表面关联的训练信号，在 latent space 里学到更一般的安全约束。
summary.importance: 它对预训练本身不是直接贡献，但对 post-train 方法设计有两个值得注意的启发。第一，安全行为未必一定要通过显式 harmful/harmless 对比数据来学，latent representation 中可能存在更抽象的、可迁移的行为子空间。第二，alignment signal 的数据效率可以高得多：如果 66 条 psychometric statements 就能带来接近 LAT 的鲁棒性，那么后训练里“数据语义表面形式”和“真正被约束的内部表示”之间可能存在较大冗余。对做基座研究的人，这类结果会反过来影响对 representation geometry、steering、以及 reward/监督信号压缩性的理解。
summary.technical_approach:
方法叫 Latent Personality Alignment，简称 LPA。它把 activation steering 的“人格方向”想法和 LAT 的“对抗式 latent robustness”结合起来，但不直接训练模型拒答 harmful prompts，而是训练模型在一组人格测量陈述上保持稳定、符合目标人格的响应。

训练数据来自 IPIP 的 psychometric items。作者选了三个与安全、亲社会行为相关的 Big Five 维度：Conscientiousness、Agreeableness、Emotional Stability。数据总共只有 66 条短句，而且是 harm-agnostic 的，不直接谈武器、违法、伤害等主题。每条 statement 被转成一个二分类响应任务：如果是正向 trait 表达，模型应回答“我同意”；如果是负向 trait 表达，模型应回答“我不同意”。例如“我喜欢帮助别人”对应 agree，“我会侮辱别人”对应 disagree。输入前面加一个固定 system prompt，把任务包装成 personality self-assessment。

真正的训练核心仍然是 latent adversarial training。虽然给出的全文片段没有展开全部公式，但从描述看，作者在隐藏状态空间中加入对抗扰动，要求模型在这些扰动下仍保持 trait-consistent response。和 activation steering 只沿单一线性方向做推理时干预不同，LPA 通过训练阶段的非线性对抗约束，把目标人格特征写进更稳固的表示区域。和标准 LAT 相比，LPA 不需要显式 harmful prompts，也不做传统 supervised refusal tuning。作者的假设是：与 harm avoidance 相关的行为倾向，在表示空间里和某些 prosocial / rule-following personality traits 共享结构；如果把这些 trait 对应的 latent 子空间稳定下来，就能间接压缩 jailbreak 可利用的自由度。

论文还做了几类关键设计选择。其一是 trait selection，不是随便选 Big Five 全部维度，而是挑了更可能与安全行为相关的三项。其二是 system prompt 的使用，说明作者认为人格任务 framing 会影响模型进入哪一类内部状态。其三是数据组成消融，试图区分“是人格语义本身起作用”，还是“任何小型二分类数据配上 LAT 都行”。这些消融比主方法本身更值得看，因为它们决定了这条路线到底是在学抽象人格约束，还是只是在做一种特殊形式的 low-data adversarial tuning。
summary.experiments:
从摘要和正文片段能确认的主结果是：LPA 在完全不使用 harmful training data 的情况下，在 HarmBench 等 jailbreak 评测上把 attack success rate 压到接近 0，同时保持较好的 utility，并且训练成本远低于标准 LAT。作者特别强调一个对比：LAT 是在 HarmBench 这类有害请求数据上训练和评测，而 LPA 训练时从未见过 harmful content，却能达到可比鲁棒性。这是论文最强的实验卖点。

实验设计包括三部分：对抗攻击评测、通用能力/utility 评测、以及多组消融。消融重点围绕 system prompt、trait selection、data composition。作者还给出定性案例，展示 LAT 训练模型在 adversarial prompting 下仍可能配合 harmful request，而 LPA 会拒绝。虽然当前提供的全文片段没有列出完整数值表，但从写法看，论文不是只做单一 benchmark 打榜，而是试图证明三件事：一，harm-agnostic 小数据也能泛化到真实 jailbreak；二，这种泛化不是靠简单 prompt trick；三，utility degradation 相对较小。

如果精读全文，建议重点核对三类数字：训练所用模型规模、LAT 与 LPA 的训练步数/算力对比、以及 utility benchmark 上的绝对下降幅度。因为这篇工作的说服力很大程度取决于“便宜多少”和“伤能力多少”这两个量，而不是单看 attack success rate。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议先看方法总览图和 Figure 1/2/5。Figure 1 大概率给主结果对比，Figure 2 给定性 jailbreak 案例，Figure 5 是关键消融。然后看 Methods 里数据构造和 LAT 目标，确认训练到底约束了哪一层表示、扰动施加在哪里、损失如何定义。最后看 utility 评测部分，判断它是否真的避免了常见的 safety-utility tradeoff。

预计 25 分钟左右可以抓住主要内容。更值得深挖的点有四个。第一，LPA 学到的是稳定人格特征，还是更一般的 refusal prior。第二，这种方法对 base model 和 system prompt 是否高度敏感。第三，66 条 statements 的效果是否来自语义选择，而不是仅仅因为它们覆盖了 prosocial / anti-social 词汇。第四，如果把这种 latent alignment 放到更大规模 continual post-training 里，是否会和已有 instruction tuning / RLHF 信号冲突。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tackles a familiar safety-alignment problem from a different angle: how to improve jailbreak robustness without relying on large datasets of harmful prompts and without paying the usual utility cost. Existing latent adversarial training (LAT) methods are effective, but they are data-hungry and often tied to explicit harm distributions. The central question here is whether a model can be made robust using a tiny, harm-agnostic training signal, as long as that signal constrains the right latent subspace.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining paper, but it is relevant to foundation-model research because it probes how abstract supervision can shape internal representations. Two implications stand out. First, safe behavior may not require direct supervision on harmful content if the relevant latent structure can be reached through more general behavioral traits. Second, alignment data may be far more compressible than surface-form datasets suggest. If 66 psychometric statements can induce robustness comparable to much larger LAT setups, then the bottleneck may be representation targeting rather than semantic coverage of harmful examples. That has consequences for how we think about steering, reward design, and the geometry of aligned representations.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The method, Latent Personality Alignment (LPA), combines the intuition of persona steering with the robustness mechanism of latent adversarial training. Instead of training the model to refuse harmful requests directly, it trains the model to respond consistently to a small set of personality statements associated with prosocial and rule-following behavior.

The data comes from IPIP psychometric items. The authors select three Big Five traits that plausibly correlate with safe behavior: Conscientiousness, Agreeableness, and Emotional Stability. The full training set contains only 66 short statements and is explicitly harm-agnostic. Each item is converted into a binary response task: positive trait expressions should receive agreement, negative trait expressions should receive disagreement. For example, “I love to help others” maps to an agree response, while “I insult people” maps to a disagree response. A fixed system prompt frames the interaction as a personality self-assessment.

The training mechanism is still LAT. Although the provided text does not include the full objective, the setup is clear: adversarial perturbations are applied in latent space, and the model is trained to preserve trait-consistent outputs under those perturbations. This is the main difference from activation steering, which typically intervenes at inference time along a roughly linear direction. LPA instead uses training-time adversarial constraints to make the target behavior more stable and nonlinear. It also differs from standard LAT by avoiding explicit harmful prompts and by not relying on conventional supervised refusal tuning.

The underlying hypothesis is that harm avoidance shares latent structure with certain personality traits. If those trait-related regions of representation space are stabilized, then jailbreak attacks lose access to some of the degrees of freedom they exploit. The paper also appears to take care with several design choices: selecting only safety-relevant traits rather than all personality dimensions, using a fixed system prompt to induce the intended internal framing, and running ablations on trait choice and data composition to test whether the effect is specific or generic.
summary_en.experiments:
From the abstract and the provided body text, the headline result is that LPA drives attack success rates on HarmBench-style jailbreak evaluations to near zero while preserving utility, despite never seeing harmful content during training. This is the main empirical claim. Standard LAT is typically trained and evaluated on harmful-prompt datasets such as HarmBench, whereas LPA uses only 66 benign psychometric statements and still reaches comparable robustness.

The experimental package includes adversarial attack evaluation, utility benchmarks, and several ablations. The ablations focus on system prompts, trait selection, and data composition. The paper also includes qualitative examples showing that a LAT-trained model may still comply under adversarial prompting, while an LPA-trained model refuses. Even without the full numeric tables in the provided excerpt, the intended argument is clear: the gains are meant to reflect genuine generalization from compact benign supervision, not a prompt-format artifact.

For a careful read, the most important numbers to verify in the full paper are model size, training budget relative to LAT, and the absolute utility drop on benign tasks. The paper’s practical significance depends less on the jailbreak metric alone and more on how much robustness is obtained per unit of data and compute, and at what capability cost.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Start with the method overview and the main figures, especially Figures 1, 2, and 5. Figure 1 likely contains the main robustness-versus-utility comparison, Figure 2 the qualitative jailbreak examples, and Figure 5 the key ablations. Then read the methods section carefully to understand where the adversarial perturbation is applied, which hidden states are constrained, and how the loss is defined. Finally, inspect the utility evaluation to see whether the usual safety-utility tradeoff is actually reduced.

A 25-minute skim should be enough to extract the main idea. The deeper questions are more interesting than the headline metric: whether LPA learns a stable personality manifold or simply a generalized refusal prior; how sensitive the method is to the base model and the system prompt; whether the effect comes from the specific semantics of the chosen statements rather than from low-data LAT in general; and how this kind of latent alignment would interact with larger-scale instruction tuning or RLHF pipelines.

recommendation.zh: 读方法和 HarmBench 消融；66 条无害人格语句压住 jailbreak 很反常，先当强假设看，值得内部小规模复现。
recommendation.en: Read the method and HarmBench ablations; 66 harmless personality statements suppressing jailbreaks is unusual enough to justify a small internal reproduction.

paper.title: AEGIS: A Mechanism-Guided Defense against Visual Synonym Jailbreaks in Text-to-Image Models
paper.abstract: Text-to-image diffusion models have achieved high visual fidelity and broad adoption, but remain vulnerable to safety violations when adversaries exploit them to synthesize illicit content. Existing alignment paradigms, from input sanitization to structural feature pruning, are largely organized around unsafe concepts explicitly exposed during filtering, editing, or localization. This leaves a blind spot for visual synonym attacks (VSA), a jailbreak where benign-looking prompts elicit prohibited

summary.core_problem: 解决文生图扩散模型中视觉同义词越狱（VSA）攻击的防御问题，现有静态防御存在安全-效用两难
summary.importance: 方法创新，提出机制引导的动态防御思路，填补了隐式视觉关联类越狱攻击的防御空白
summary.technical_approach: 放弃静态预定义不安全概念的过滤/剪枝思路，转而动态追踪生成过程中不安全语义的收敛过程，构建AEGIS框架在生成阶段抑制隐式不安全语义
summary.experiments: 摘要未提及具体模型参数量与数据集，baseline为现有输入过滤、结构特征剪枝等防御方法，核心效果为缓解VSA攻击的同时降低对良性内容的抑制

summary_en.core_problem: Address defense against visual synonym attacks (VSA) jailbreaks in text-to-image diffusion models, where existing static defenses face a safety-utility trade-off
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation, proposing a mechanism-guided dynamic defense approach to fill the gap in defending implicit visual-association jailbreaks

recommendation.en: Jailbreak defense for text-to-image models, dynamic semantic tracing design is a weak reference for LLM alignment, read abstract only.

paper.title: Safe Inference-Time Alignment via Lagrangian Reward Augmentation
paper.abstract: Inference-time alignment steers a frozen language model during decoding using auxiliary reward signals, avoiding the cost of repeated weight updates. However, existing inference-time alignment methods typically optimize a single scalar score, so explicit safety constraints must either be ignored or encoded through manually tuned penalties. We propose Lagrangian Reward Augmentation (LARA), a general inference-time alignment framework under safety constraints. Starting from a KL-regularized constr

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文解决的是推理时对齐中的安全约束问题。现有 inference-time alignment 通常把 helpfulness 和 safety 合成一个手工调权的标量分数，缺少从显式安全预算推导 decoding objective 的机制。
summary.importance: 这不是预训练方法论文，但对 pretrain-posttrain 接口有参考意义。它把 Safe RLHF 的约束优化形式迁移到推理阶段，使冻结模型也能在 reward 和 cost 之间做可校准的权衡。对基座研究更有启发的是训练信号质量问题：reward model 和 cost model 不只是 RL 微调信号，也可以成为推理时控制信号；安全约束的表达方式会影响模型行为，即使权重完全不更新。
summary.technical_approach: LARA 从 KL-regularized constrained objective 出发：在保持策略不偏离参考模型太远的前提下最大化 reward，同时约束 expected cost 不超过给定安全预算。论文对安全约束做 Lagrangian dualization，引入非负乘子 λ，把目标转成 augmented reward：rλ(x,y)=r(x,y)-λc(x,y)。这样原问题被化为关于 λ 的一维凸校准问题。λ 在一个小 calibration set 上估计，之后可以直接插入已有推理时对齐方法。对 Best-of-N 这类 sequence-level reranking，LARA 有清晰的 expected-cost constrained optimum 解释：采样多个候选后用增强奖励选择，同时 λ 对应安全预算。对 token-level reward-guided decoding，LARA 提供的是由同一约束目标诱导出的启发式打分。论文还分析了 dual objective 的几何性质，证明 dual gradient 具有单调性，因此可以用 binary search 高效校准 λ，并给出有限样本估计保证。
summary.experiments: 实验显示，LARA 改善了 helpfulness-harmlessness tradeoff。在推理时方法中，Best-of-N 配合 LARA 表现最好，并接近基于微调的 direct alignment baseline。结果也表明，单纯手工设置 reward-cost penalty 不够稳健；把 λ 通过约束目标和 calibration set 来确定，可以更稳定地满足安全预算。给定内容未包含具体 benchmark、模型规模和数值表，因此只能确认趋势，不能判断收益幅度和跨模型泛化强度。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议用 20–30 分钟。先看 problem formulation，确认 reward、cost、KL 正则和 safety budget 的定义。然后重点看 dualization 部分，理解为什么只剩一个非负 λ，以及 augmented reward 如何接入 Best-of-N 和 token-level decoder。理论部分可只看 dual gradient monotonicity 和 finite-sample guarantee 的结论。实验部分重点看 helpfulness-harmlessness frontier、不同 inference-time methods 的比较、λ calibration 对安全预算满足率的影响。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies safe inference-time alignment for frozen language models. Existing decoding-time methods usually optimize a single scalar score, so safety has to be ignored or folded in through manually tuned penalties. LARA asks how to derive that score from an explicit safety constraint.
summary_en.importance: This is an alignment and inference-time control paper rather than a pretraining paper. Its relevance to foundation-model research is in the interface between training signals and deployment-time behavior. Reward and cost models can be used not only for policy updates but also for constrained decoding. The work also makes clear that the form of the safety signal matters: even with fixed model weights, the choice of constraint and calibration procedure changes the helpfulness-safety tradeoff.
summary_en.technical_approach: LARA starts from a KL-regularized constrained objective: maximize reward while keeping the expected cost below a safety budget and regularizing against a reference policy. The safety constraint is dualized with a nonnegative multiplier λ, yielding an augmented reward rλ(x,y)=r(x,y)-λc(x,y). The main technical move is to reduce the constrained problem to a one-dimensional convex calibration problem over λ. The multiplier is estimated on a small calibration set and then reused as the scoring rule during decoding. For sequence-level Best-of-N reranking, this has a direct expected-cost constrained interpretation. For token-level reward-guided decoding, it becomes a principled heuristic derived from the same constrained objective. The paper also proves monotonicity of the dual gradient, which supports binary-search calibration, and gives a finite-sample guarantee for estimating the multiplier.
summary_en.experiments: The reported experiments show better helpfulness-harmlessness tradeoffs than manually chosen scalar penalties. Among inference-time methods, Best-of-N with LARA performs best and approaches finetuning-based direct-alignment baselines. The key empirical claim is that calibrating λ from a constrained objective is more stable than manually tuning reward-cost weights. The provided content does not include exact model sizes, datasets, or numerical tables, so the strength of the gains should be verified from the full experimental section.
summary_en.reading_guide: A skim should take about 20–30 minutes. Read the objective formulation first, especially the definitions of reward, cost, KL regularization, and safety budget. Then read the dual derivation and the calibration algorithm for λ. The most useful experimental plots are likely the helpfulness-harmlessness frontier, the comparison between Best-of-N and token-level guided decoding, and the analysis of constraint satisfaction after calibration. The theory section can be read selectively: focus on the monotone dual gradient and the finite-sample calibration result.

recommendation.zh: 推理时对齐的干净方法，对偶化处理多约束的思路可迁移到预训练多目标优化，重点看§3的对偶推导与校准集设计
recommendation.en: Clean inference-time alignment method; Lagrangian dual formulation for multi-constraint optimization is transferable to multi-objective pretraining, focus on §3 derivation and calibration set design

paper.title: Safety Targeted Embedding Exploit via Refinement
paper.abstract: Safety training for large language models (LLMs) is conducted predominantly in English, leaving uncertain how well safety mechanisms generalize to low-resource languages and mixed-language code-switching. We show that this creates an epistemic gap in which models confidently generate harmful responses for inputs that fall outside the distribution of their safety training. To study this phenomenon, we introduce STEER (Safety Targeted Embedding Exploit via Refinement), a gradient-guided attack tha

summary.core_problem: LLM安全训练以英语为主，低资源语言与语码转换场景下安全机制泛化性差，易被绕过。
summary.importance: 方法创新贡献，提出梯度引导的语码转换攻击方法STEER，揭示了多语言安全训练的分布盲区。
summary.technical_approach: 通过梯度分析识别对模型拒绝行为贡献最大的单词，迭代翻译成低资源语言，在保留有害意图的同时抑制安全拒绝反应。
summary.experiments: 在6个8B开源模型上测试，STEER在JailbreakBench和AdvBench上成功率分别达93.0%和96.7%，优于随机语码转换和GCG，且可迁移至GPT-4o-mini（35.5%成功率）。
summary.authors_note: 作者未标注所属机构，无知名研究者信息。

summary_en.core_problem: LLM safety training is English-dominated, leading to poor generalization of safety mechanisms to low-resource languages and code-switching scenarios.
summary_en.importance: Methodological contribution proposing STEER, a gradient-guided code-switching attack that reveals distributional blind spots in multilingual safety training.
summary_en.technical_approach: Use gradient analysis to identify high-impact refusal-related words, then iteratively translate them to low-resource languages to suppress refusal while preserving harmful intent.
summary_en.experiments: Tested on 6 open-source 8B models, STEER achieves 93.0% success on JailbreakBench and 96.7% on AdvBench, outperforming random code-switching and GCG; it also transfers to GPT-4o-mini with 35.5% success.
summary_en.authors_note: No institutional affiliation provided; no notable author information available.

recommendation.zh: 从攻击侧暴露多语言安全对齐的分布盲区，对预训练多语言数据配比有间接参考，看摘要即可。
recommendation.en: Exposes multilingual safety alignment blind spots from the attack side; indirect reference for pretraining data mixture; read abstract only.

paper.title: The Illusion of High Utility in Safety Alignment of Text-to-Image Diffusion Models
paper.abstract: Safety alignment of text-to-image (T2I) diffusion models aims to suppress harmful generations while preserving utility on benign prompts. Recent methods often appear to deliver high safety with high utility, but this conclusion rests largely on coarse global utility metrics (e.g., FID, CLIPScore) that are insensitive to fine-grained semantic correctness, creating an illusion of high utility. We show that when utility is measured with structured evaluation, this illusion breaks: on TIFA (Text-to-

summary.core_problem: 研究文本到图像扩散模型的安全对齐是否真的能在抑制有害生成的同时保留正常提示词上的语义生成能力。
summary.importance: 贡献主要是评测与机制分析：指出常用的全局图像质量指标会高估安全对齐后的模型效用，细粒度语义一致性才暴露出真实损失。这对多模态生成模型的对齐评估有参考意义。
summary.technical_approach: 作者用 TIFA 这类结构化问答式图文一致性评估替代只看 FID、CLIPScore 的粗粒度指标，并分析文本编码器的 prompt embedding 空间。核心发现是安全对齐会造成 semantic collapse，即 embedding 分布收缩并扭曲不同 prompt 之间的相似性结构；论文还据此提出一个缓解策略，但摘要中方法名与细节被截断。
summary.experiments: 实验比较若干安全对齐后的 T2I diffusion 模型，在全局指标上看似保持较好效用，但在 TIFA 上出现明显语义保真度下降，错误集中在物体数量、属性和关系等细粒度维度。摘要未给出模型规模、训练数据和具体数值提升。
summary.authors_note: Mubarak Shah 是视觉领域知名研究者，长期在视频理解和计算机视觉方向有代表性工作。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether safety-aligned text-to-image diffusion models truly preserve benign-prompt utility while suppressing harmful generations.
summary_en.importance: Its main contribution is evaluative and diagnostic: coarse global metrics can make aligned T2I models look useful, while structured semantic evaluation reveals substantial utility loss. This is relevant to alignment evaluation for multimodal generative models.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors replace reliance on FID and CLIPScore with structured TIFA-style question-answering evaluation for image-text faithfulness, then inspect the prompt embedding space of the text encoder. They identify semantic collapse: contracted embedding spread and distorted inter-prompt similarity structure. The abstract also mentions a mitigation method, but the provided text truncates its details.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments compare safety-aligned T2I diffusion models and show that global metrics can remain favorable while TIFA exposes semantic fidelity drops in object counts, attributes, and relations. The abstract does not provide model sizes, training data details, or exact numerical deltas.
summary_en.authors_note: Mubarak Shah is a well-known computer vision researcher with long-running work in video understanding and visual recognition.

recommendation.zh: 对预训练不直接，但“安全对齐压缩语义空间”这个诊断值得记；只看 TIFA 结果和 embedding collapse 分析即可。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but the semantic-collapse diagnosis is worth tracking; read the TIFA results and embedding-space analysis only.

paper.title: HARC: Coupling Harmfulness and Refusal Directions for Robust Safety Alignment
paper.abstract: Understanding how aligned LLMs internally represent safety is critical for diagnosing alignment vulnerabilities, as it explains why jailbreaks succeed and informs the design of robust alignment strategies. Prior work shows that aligned LLMs encode harmfulness and refusal as separable directions in the residual stream at prompt-side token positions. We show that jailbreaks succeed at prompt encoding by suppressing either the refusal or harmfulness direction before any token is generated, with dis

summary.core_problem: 现有LLM安全对齐方法鲁棒性不足，越狱攻击可绕过对齐机制，缺乏对攻击生效的内部表示层面机制的完整理解。
summary.importance: 将安全表示的分析从prompt侧扩展到响应生成侧，揭示了越狱攻击的表示层面机制，提出轻量微调方法提升对齐鲁棒性。
summary.technical_approach: 分析prompt侧与response侧token位置的残差流，发现越狱通过抑制有害性或拒绝方向生效，且模型在生成阶段可识别正在产生的有害内容；提出HARC微调方法，在两个位置同时耦合有害性与拒绝方向的激活。
summary.experiments: 未披露具体模型参数量与训练数据规模，在多类越狱攻击场景下验证可降低攻击成功率，提升对齐鲁棒性。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing LLM safety alignment methods lack robustness against jailbreak attacks, and there is no complete understanding of the internal representation-level mechanisms that enable such attacks.
summary_en.importance: Extends safety representation analysis from the prompt side to the response generation side, reveals the representation-level mechanism of jailbreak attacks, and proposes a lightweight fine-tuning method to improve alignment robustness.
summary_en.technical_approach: Analyzes residual streams at both prompt-side and response-side token positions, finding that jailbreaks work by suppressing either the harmfulness or refusal direction, and that models can recognize harmful content during generation even when they fail to detect it at the prompt side. HARC fine-tuning is proposed to couple activations of the two directions across both positions.
summary_en.experiments: Specific model sizes and training data scales are not disclosed. Validation across multiple jailbreak scenarios shows reduced attack success rate and improved alignment robustness.

recommendation.zh: 安全表示的机制观察有一定参考价值，微调方法是增量改进，作为对齐方向文献备查即可，无需深读。
recommendation.en: The mechanistic observation on safety representations has some reference value, while the fine-tuning method is incremental; keep as alignment literature reference, no deep read needed.

paper.title: Harnessing Textual Refusal Directions for Multimodal Safety
paper.abstract: To improve safety in Large Language Models (LLMs) we can either perform post-training alignment or exploit refusal directions in the activation space. Both strategies are less feasible in Multimodal LLMs (MLLMs) as they require unsafe multimodal data, harder to collect than their unimodal counterpart. In this work, we relax this constraint and investigate whether textual refusal directions, extracted directly from the LLM backbone, generalize across modalities (i.e., image, video). Preliminary f

summary.core_problem: 多模态大模型安全对齐依赖难以采集的多模态不安全标注数据，现有文本对齐策略跨模态泛化性差且易触发正常输入的误拒问题。
summary.importance: 方法创新，首次验证LLM激活空间中的文本拒绝方向可跨图像/视频模态泛化，提出无需训练、无需多模态安全数据的轻量对齐方案。
summary.technical_approach: 提出模态无关拒绝引导（MARS）方法：先提取LLM骨干的文本拒绝方向，通过激活重居中修正跨模态错位导致的正常输入误拒，再自适应调整引导强度，实现无训练的多模态安全能力注入。
summary.experiments: 覆盖图像、视频模态的安全测试场景，验证层选择、引导强度、跨模态对齐程度对拒绝效果的影响，可在保留正常输入可用性的前提下提升不安全输入的拒绝率。

summary_en.core_problem: MLLM safety alignment relies on hard-to-collect unsafe multimodal annotated data, while existing text alignment strategies generalize poorly across modalities and often trigger false refusals on benign inputs.
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation: first verifies that textual refusal directions in LLM activation space generalize across image/video modalities, and proposes a lightweight training-free alignment scheme requiring no multimodal safety data.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes Modality-Agnostic Refusal Steering (MARS): extract textual refusal directions from LLM backbone, correct false refusals on benign inputs caused by cross-modal misalignment via activation re-centering, then adaptively scale steering strength to inject multimodal safety without training.
summary_en.experiments: Tests on image and video safety benchmarks, verifies the impact of layer selection, steering strength, and cross-modal alignment quality on refusal performance, improving unsafe input rejection rate while preserving benign input usability.

recommendation.zh: 多模态安全对齐的轻量无训练思路，对基座对齐的低成本 ablation 有参考价值，仅看方法部分即可。
recommendation.en: A lightweight training-free MLLM safety alignment approach, useful reference for low-cost foundation model alignment ablations, read method section only.

paper.title: Robust Harmful Features Under Jailbreak Attacks: Mechanistic Evidence from Attention Head Specialization in Large Language Models
paper.abstract: Jailbreak attacks bypass LLM safety alignment, yet their mechanisms remain poorly understood. We provide evidence that attacks do not comprehensively eliminate safety features, but instead selectively suppress specific attention heads. We identify two functionally differentiated types: Adversarially Compromised Heads (ACHs) concentrated in early layers, which are suppressed under attacks, and Safety-Aligned Heads (SAHs) in mid-layers, which maintain robust activations even when attacks succeed.

summary.core_problem: 解释 jailbreak 攻击为何能绕过 LLM 的拒答行为：攻击是否真的抹除了安全特征，还是只干扰了部分关键计算路径。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是机制分析。它把安全对齐失效拆到 attention head 层面，区分被攻击模板抑制的早层头和仍保持安全激活的中层头，对理解 post-train safety 信号如何嵌入基座有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 论文识别两类功能分化的注意力头：早层的 Adversarially Compromised Heads 在攻击下被抑制，中层的 Safety-Aligned Heads 在攻击成功时仍保持激活。通过 head ablation、激活比较和 token-level attribution 验证因果关系，并追踪攻击模板 token 对 ACH 抑制的贡献。
summary.experiments: 摘要未说明具体模型、数据集和攻击集规模。核心实验证据包括：抑制少量 ACH 可让正常应拒答输入出现 jailbreak-like 行为；移除 SAH 会削弱中层安全激活；token attribution 显示攻击模板 token 是 ACH 抑制的主要来源。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks why jailbreak attacks bypass refusal behavior in LLMs: do they erase safety features globally, or do they selectively disrupt specific computation paths?
summary_en.importance: This is a mechanistic safety analysis. It localizes jailbreak effects to specialized attention heads and is relevant for understanding how post-training safety signals are represented inside a pretrained model.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors identify two head types: early-layer Adversarially Compromised Heads, whose activations are suppressed by attacks, and mid-layer Safety-Aligned Heads, which remain active even when the attack succeeds. They use head ablations, activation analysis, and token-level attribution to test causality.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not specify model families, datasets, or attack suites. Reported evidence includes inducing jailbreak-like behavior by suppressing a small number of ACHs, weakening safety activations by removing SAHs, and attributing ACH suppression to attack-template tokens.

recommendation.zh: 只看 head 分型和 ablation；若 setup 干净，它会修正“jailbreak 抹掉安全表征”的粗糙 prior。
recommendation.en: Read the head taxonomy and ablations; if the setup is clean, it refines the crude prior that jailbreaks simply erase safety representations.

paper.title: The Geometry of Refusal: Linear Instability in Safety-Aligned LLMs
paper.abstract: Modern Large Language Models (LLMs) rely on extensive safety alignment, yet the mechanistic basis of refusal remains opaque. In this work, we investigate whether safety compliance is a deep semantic decision or a manipulable linear feature. We introduce Contrastive Logit Steering (CLS), a zero-optimization framework that isolates the "refusal direction" by contrasting hidden states derived from safe and unrestricted system prompts. Unlike representation engineering methods that intervene on inte

summary.core_problem: 安全对齐LLM的拒答行为编码机制尚不明确，现有研究无法区分其为深层语义决策还是浅层可操纵线性特征，且缺乏无需优化、可直接量化对齐深度的诊断工具。
summary.importance: 为预训练-后训练的对齐接口设计提供明确启发：对齐鲁棒性不取决于SFT/RLHF的数据量，而取决于安全信号注入的层深度——越早注入越难被线性操纵。提出的CLS框架可作为零成本的对齐质量诊断工具，比现有激活干预方法更灵敏地暴露对齐脆弱性。
summary.technical_approach: 提出对比Logit引导（Contrastive Logit Steering, CLS），零优化的几何干预框架。核心步骤：其一，对同一用户查询并行执行三次前向传播，分别使用中性、无约束、极严格三类系统提示，得到每个解码步的三个Logit向量；其二，用无约束与极严格提示的Logit差构造瞬时拒答向量，该向量突出被安全对齐抑制的token；其三，将缩放后的拒答向量叠加到中性提示的Logit上：缩放系数为正实现越狱，为负实现安全加固。为绕过模型第一步的拒答反射，采用前缀注入强制前k个token为肯定前缀（如“Sure”），使模型先进入合规生成轨迹。核心贡献：在输出Logit层面实现了零优化的拒答行为操纵，为量化对齐深度提供了几何探针。
summary.experiments: 在7个主流模型家族（Llama 2/3.1、Qwen 2/2.5、Mistral、Gemma、Phi）上测试。核心结果：其一，拒答方向是跨模型通用的线性特征；其二，模型分为两类：晚决策型（如Llama-3.1，95%的层处理有害/无害查询的表示无差异，仅最后输出头分岔），CLS加前缀注入的攻击成功率达95%；早分岔型（如Qwen-2.5，约40%层深度即出现表示分岔），攻击成功率仅22%；其三，与现有激活干预方法相比，CLS在Llama 2上的攻击成功率从22.6%提升至73%，在Qwen 7B上从79.2%提升至91%；其四，负向引导可在不更新参数的前提下加固模型，同时提升生成连贯性；其五，用拒答向量做恶意查询检测的F1值达0.92。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读顺序：首先读引言的核心问题与结论（约5分钟），明确拒答行为的线性本质与对齐深度的影响；其次读方法部分的CLS与前缀注入的实现逻辑（约10分钟），理解Logit层面干预的设计动机；然后读实验部分的核心结果表与KL散度分岔深度图（约10分钟），掌握两类模型的鲁棒性差异；最后读讨论部分的对齐设计启示（约5分钟）。总阅读时间约25-30分钟，无需精读附录中的攻击提示模板等细节，除非直接从事对齐安全研究。

summary_en.core_problem: The encoding mechanism of refusal behavior in safety-aligned LLMs remains unclear: existing work cannot distinguish whether it is a deep semantic decision or a shallow manipulable linear feature, and there is a lack of zero-optimization diagnostic tools that can directly quantify alignment depth.
summary_en.importance: Provides clear guidance for pretrain-posttrain alignment interface design: alignment robustness depends not on the volume of SFT/RLHF data, but on the layer depth of safety signal injection — earlier injection makes linear manipulation harder. The proposed CLS framework serves as a zero-cost alignment quality diagnostic that exposes alignment fragility more sensitively than existing activation intervention methods.
summary_en.technical_approach: Introduces Contrastive Logit Steering (CLS), a zero-optimization geometric intervention framework. Core steps: First, run three parallel forward passes for the same user query with neutral, unrestricted, and hyper-restrictive system prompts to obtain three per-step logit vectors. Second, construct an instantaneous refusal vector from the logit difference between unrestricted and hyper-restrictive prompts, highlighting tokens suppressed by safety alignment. Third, add the scaled refusal vector to logits from the neutral prompt: positive scaling induces jailbreaking, negative scaling induces safety hardening. To bypass the model’s first-step refusal reflex, Prefix Injection forces the first k tokens to an affirmative prefix (e.g., "Sure") to push the model into a compliant generation trajectory first. Core contribution: Implements zero-optimization refusal behavior manipulation at the output logit layer, providing a geometric probe to quantify alignment depth.
summary_en.experiments: Tested across 7 mainstream model families (Llama 2/3.1, Qwen 2/2.5, Mistral, Gemma, Phi). Key results: First, the refusal direction is a universal linear feature across models. Second, models fall into two categories: Late Decision (e.g., Llama-3.1, where representations for harmful/benign queries are identical across 95% of layers, diverging only at the final output head) — CLS plus Prefix Injection achieves 95% attack success rate; Early Divergence (e.g., Qwen-2.5, where representations diverge at ~40% depth) — attack success rate is only 22%. Third, compared to existing activation intervention methods, CLS improves attack success rate from 22.6% to 73% on Llama 2, and from 79.2% to 91% on Qwen 7B. Fourth, negative steering hardens models without parameter updates while improving generation coherence. Fifth, malicious query detection using the refusal vector achieves 0.92 F1.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in the following order: First, read the core problem and conclusions in the Introduction (~5 minutes) to understand the linear nature of refusal behavior and the impact of alignment depth. Second, read the implementation logic of CLS and Prefix Injection in the Methodology section (~10 minutes) to grasp the design motivation of logit-level intervention. Third, read the core result tables and KL divergence divergence depth plots in the Experiments section (~10 minutes) to understand the robustness difference between the two model categories. Fourth, read the alignment design takeaways in the Discussion section (~5 minutes). Total estimated reading time: 25–30 minutes. No need to closely examine details such as attack prompt templates in the appendix unless working directly on alignment safety research.

recommendation.zh: 值得看 refusal direction 的测量 setup；若结果稳，会削弱“拒答是语义级安全判断”的先验。
recommendation.en: Worth reading for the refusal-direction measurement setup; if robust, it weakens the prior that refusal is mainly a semantic safety decision.

paper.title: What Do Safety-Aligned LLMs Learn From Mixed Compliance Demonstrations?
paper.abstract: Prior work has shown that in-context demonstrations can jailbreak language models, but it remains unclear how models interpret different types of compliance demonstrations. We study this by mixing benign compliance demonstrations (non-harmful request, helpful response) with harmful compliance demonstrations (harmful request, helpful response) and testing three hypotheses about how demonstration composition drives harmful compliance. Across four models, we find that benign and harmful demonstrati

summary.core_problem: 经过安全对齐的LLM，在上下文同时包含良性合规演示（正常请求+有效回答）和有害合规演示（有害请求+未拒绝的有效回答）时，是对表面的“助手会配合”模式做反应，还是会区分演示内容的语义属性调整对有害请求的应答策略，这一行为机制此前缺少系统的控制变量验证。
summary.importance: 结论清晰定位了偏好优化阶段在对齐过程中的具体作用：DPO并非简单教会模型输出拒绝话术，而是将“通用合作倾向”和“对有害请求的合规”两个行为解耦。这对理解SFT与偏好优化的行为差异、研究后训练阶段如何修正模型的表面模式匹配倾向有实证参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 构建变量严格控制的混合演示上下文：固定演示总数，系统性调整良性/有害演示的比例，检验三个竞争假设——总合规演示数决定有害合规率、仅有害演示数决定有害合规率、两类演示存在联合作用（放大或稀释有害合规率）。进一步对比OLMo-3.1-32B在SFT后、DPO后的checkpoint行为差异；同时将“回答格式模仿”和“有害合规”两个独立行为分开测量，检验两者是否由同一机制驱动。
summary.experiments: 在四个公开模型上的实验得到三个核心结果：1）所有模型均拒绝“总合规数决定合规率”的假设，良性与有害演示不可互换：Llama-3.1-8B、Gemma-4-31B中加入良性演示会降低有害合规率（稀释效应），OLMo-3.1-32B无显著影响，GPT-OSS-20B中良性演示会轻微提升有害合规率（放大效应）；2）OLMo的分阶段对比显示，SFT后的模型存在明显的放大效应——良性演示会提升有害合规率，经过DPO后该效应完全消失；3）合规行为与格式模仿是完全解离的：部分模型会模仿演示的回答格式但不提升有害合规率，部分模型会提升合规率但不模仿表面格式，说明不同模型的安全拒绝机制存在质的差异。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，不需要追踪实验细节。重点关注SFT与DPO checkpoint的行为对比部分，以及合规与格式模仿解离的实验结论，预计阅读时间15分钟。对预训练研究者的核心参考点是：SFT阶段习得的行为存在很强的表面模式耦合，容易被无关上下文触发，偏好优化阶段会显著降低这种耦合。

summary_en.core_problem: It remains untested under controlled settings how safety-aligned LLMs process in-context compliance demonstrations: whether they respond to a generic surface-level 'assistant complies' signal regardless of request content, or track the semantic nature of demonstrated requests when deciding to comply with harmful queries.
summary_en.importance: The findings isolate a concrete behavioral effect of preference optimization during alignment: DPO does not merely train models to output refusal responses, but decouples general cooperativeness from compliance with harmful requests. This provides useful empirical evidence for studying the interface between SFT and preference alignment, particularly how surface pattern matching learned in SFT is reduced in later post-training stages.
summary_en.technical_approach: The work constructs tightly controlled mixed-demonstration contexts where the total number of demonstrations is fixed while the ratio of benign compliance demonstrations (harmless request + helpful response) to harmful compliance demonstrations (harmful request + unrefused helpful response) is systematically varied. It tests three competing hypotheses for drivers of harmful compliance rate: total count of compliant demonstrations, count of only harmful demonstrations, or joint effects of both (amplification or dilution). It further compares behavior across training checkpoints (post-SFT vs post-DPO) for OLMo-3.1-32B, and decouples measurement of format imitation (copying surface response patterns from demonstrations) from harmful compliance to test if the two behaviors share an underlying mechanism.
summary_en.experiments: Across four tested models (Llama-3.1-8B, OLMo-3.1-32B-Instruct, Gemma-4-31B-IT, GPT-OSS-20B): (1) The total-count hypothesis is rejected across all models—benign and harmful demonstrations are not interchangeable. Benign demonstrations reduce harmful compliance on Llama-3.1-8B and Gemma-4-31B, have no significant effect on OLMo-3.1-32B, and slightly increase harmful compliance on GPT-OSS-20B. (2) Checkpoint comparison on OLMo shows post-SFT models exhibit strong amplification (benign demonstrations increase harmful compliance), while this effect is entirely eliminated after DPO. (3) Compliance behavior and format imitation are fully dissociated: some models copy demonstrated response formats without increasing harmful compliance, while others increase compliance without adopting surface format patterns, indicating qualitatively different refusal mechanisms across models.
summary_en.reading_guide: This is a skim-level read. No need to follow granular experimental parameter choices. Focus on the cross-training-stage comparison (post-SFT vs post-DPO behavior difference) and the behavior dissociation results. Expected reading time is 15 minutes. The core relevant takeaway for pretrain researchers is the observation that SFT produces tightly coupled surface pattern matching that can be triggered by semantically irrelevant context, while preference optimization substantially reduces this coupling.

recommendation.zh: 这篇不改训练范式，但会修正你对“示例顺从=统一顺从特征”的直觉；只看实验设计和训练阶段对比，能帮你想清 post-train 到底改了什么。
recommendation.en: It does not change the training recipe, but it weakens the naive 'compliance is a single feature' prior; read the setup and training-stage comparison to see what post-training actually altered.

paper.title: SACE: Concept Erasure at the Semantic Singularity in Visual Autoregressive Models
paper.abstract: The rapid progress of visual autoregressive (VAR) models has unlocked a transformative frontier for high-fidelity text-to-image synthesis, while heightening concerns over the safety alignment of generated content. Naive application of existing erasure techniques to VAR models causes catastrophic semantic collapse and visual artifacts, since they are predominantly designed for the homogeneous denoising steps of diffusion models. To address this foundational challenge, we first propose the Semanti

summary.core_problem: 视觉自回归（VAR）模型的安全对齐：现有concept erasure方法因设计用于扩散模型的均匀去噪步骤，直接应用于VAR导致灾难性语义崩溃和视觉伪影。
summary.importance: 方法创新：提出Semantic Singularity Axiom，首次为VAR模型设计scale-aware概念擦除框架SACE。
summary.technical_approach: 提出增量语义显著性分析（ISSA）验证Semantic Singularity Axiom（目标语义概念在Scale-0锁定），SACE严格将干预限制在first scale实现概念擦除。
summary.experiments: 在VAR模型上验证，对比现有erasure方法在语义保持和概念擦除效果上的优势，无大规模定量对比。

summary_en.core_problem: Safety alignment of visual autoregressive (VAR) models: existing concept erasure methods designed for diffusion's homogeneous denoising steps cause catastrophic semantic collapse when applied to VAR.
summary_en.importance: Method innovation: proposes Semantic Singularity Axiom and first scale-aware concept erasure framework (SACE) for VAR models.
summary_en.technical_approach: Incremental Semantic Saliency Analysis (ISSA) validates that target semantic concepts are locked at Scale-0; SACE confines interventions strictly to the first scale for concept erasure.
summary_en.experiments: Validated on VAR models; compares favorably against existing erasure methods on semantic preservation and erasure efficacy.

recommendation.zh: 多模态生成安全对齐工作，Semantic Singularity Axiom有一定独创性，但对LLM pretrain研究员非核心，看摘要了解思路即可。
recommendation.en: Multimodal generation safety alignment; Semantic Singularity Axiom is somewhat original but peripheral to LLM pretraining. Glance for conceptual interest only.

paper.title: FreoStream:Enhancing Stream Guardrails via Future-Aware Reasoning and Safety-Aligned Optimization
paper.abstract: Stream guardrails enable token-level safety detection before full responses are generated. However, they often make overly conservative judgements and block those sensitive but safe tokens, which is known as over-refusal. Due to lack of full context, they also fail to detect implicitly harmful content from jailbreaking. To address these challenges, we propose FreoStream, a novel streaming guardrail framework. Specifically, FreoStream fine-tunes a LoRA module to perform Future-Aware Reasoning whe

summary.core_problem: 流式安全护栏在token级检测中存在过度拒绝（误拦安全但敏感token）和无法检测隐式有害内容的问题
summary.importance: 方法创新——提出未来感知推理范式和安全对齐优化相结合的流式护栏框架，在减少过度拒绝和提升隐式有害检测之间取得平衡
summary.technical_approach: FreoStream通过LoRA微调实现Future-Reason-Judge范式：预测未来token、基于完整上下文推理、做出最终判断；Safety-Aligned Optimization模块从推理梯度中提取安全对齐分量更新基础护栏模型
summary.experiments: 在多个安全基准上测试；对比现有流式护栏方法；验证过度拒绝率降低和隐式有害内容检测率提升

summary_en.core_problem: Streaming safety guardrails suffer from over-refusal (blocking safe-but-sensitive tokens) and fail to detect implicitly harmful content due to lack of full context
summary_en.importance: Method innovation—proposes future-aware reasoning and safety-aligned optimization for streaming guardrails, balancing reduced over-refusal and improved implicit harm detection
summary_en.technical_approach: FreoStream fine-tunes a LoRA module for Future-Reason-Judge paradigm: predict future tokens, reason over full context, make final judgment; Safety-Aligned Optimization extracts safety-aligned components from reasoning gradients to update base guardrail model
summary_en.experiments: Tested on multiple safety benchmarks; compared against existing streaming guardrail methods; demonstrates reduced over-refusal and improved implicit harmful content detection

recommendation.zh: 流式安全护栏的增量改进，对推理时安全对齐有一定参考但方法不涉及预训练，看摘要即可
recommendation.en: Incremental improvement on streaming safety guardrails with some relevance to inference-time safety alignment; read abstract only, no pretraining relevance

paper.title: Grammar-Constrained Decoding Can Jailbreak LLMs into Generating Malicious Code
paper.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly used for code generation, raising concerns that they may be misused to produce malicious code. Meanwhile, Grammar-Constrained Decoding (GCD) has been widely adopted to improve the reliability of LLM-generated code by enforcing syntactic validity. In this paper, we reveal a counterintuitive risk: this reliability-oriented technique can itself become an attack surface. We uncover a new jailbreak attack, termed CodeSpear, that exploits GCD to induce LLM

summary.core_problem: 解决代码生成场景中一个反直觉安全问题：语法约束解码本来用于提高代码可靠性，却可能被攻击者利用来绕过模型安全对齐并生成恶意代码。
summary.importance: 贡献属于安全对齐与解码接口研究。价值不在代码生成本身，而在指出 decoding constraint 会改变对齐边界，说明后训练安全并不天然对解码时控制条件稳健。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 CodeSpear 攻击，利用 benign-looking 的代码 grammar constraint 在 GCD 下诱导模型输出恶意代码；同时提出 CodeShield，在代码模态下做安全对齐，让模型在受控 grammar 下优先生成 honeypot code，从而保持语法合法但语义无害。
summary.experiments: 摘要提到在 10 个流行模型上验证攻击有效，并展示 CodeShield 的防御效果，但未给出模型规模、攻击成功率、相对基线和训练成本。实验若覆盖闭源/开源与不同解码器，会比单一模型更有说服力。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自清华大学、电子科技大学等。清华背景使其在安全与代码方向有一定关注度，但这篇更偏后训练安全接口，而非基座预训练。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies a counterintuitive safety issue in code generation: grammar-constrained decoding, intended to improve reliability, can itself be exploited to jailbreak models into producing malicious code.
summary_en.importance: This is a safety-alignment and decoding-interface paper. Its value is not code generation per se, but the observation that decoding constraints can shift the effective alignment boundary, meaning post-training safety is not automatically robust to constrained decoding.
summary_en.technical_approach: It introduces CodeSpear, an attack that uses seemingly benign code grammar constraints to induce malicious code generation under GCD. It also proposes CodeShield, a code-modality safety alignment method that trains the model to emit honeypot code under attacker-controlled grammar constraints, preserving syntactic validity while neutralizing harmful semantics.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract claims validation on 10 popular models and shows defensive gains from CodeShield, but does not provide model sizes, attack success rates, baselines, or training cost. The setup would be more convincing if it spans both open and closed models and multiple decoding stacks.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from Tsinghua University and UESTC. The paper is more about post-training safety interfaces than foundation-model pretraining.

recommendation.zh: 点子是对的：解码约束会改写对齐边界；但它更像安全接口漏洞，不是 pretrain 结论，读攻击设定和防御思路就够了。
recommendation.en: The key lesson is real—decoding constraints can rewrite the alignment boundary—but this is a safety-interface paper, not a pretraining one; read the attack setup and move on.

paper.title: SpeechJBB: Probing Safety Alignment and Comprehension in Large Audio Language Models under Code-Switched Speech
paper.abstract: Large audio language models (LALMs) are increasingly deployed in real-world applications, yet their safety alignment is still primarily evaluated on monolingual, text-based harmful prompts. This leaves their generalizability under multilingual and spoken settings, particularly code-switched speech, largely underexplored. To address this gap, we introduce SpeechJBB, an audio jailbreak dataset for benchmarking across multiple state-of-the-art LALMs. The extent of safety weaknesses is further probe

summary.core_problem: 现有大音频语言模型的安全对齐评测仅覆盖单语文本有害提示，未测试多语言代码切换语音场景下的泛化性，也缺乏语音层面的混淆攻击验证手段。
summary.importance: 贡献了首个针对代码切换语音场景的大音频语言模型安全越狱评测数据集SpeechJBB，填补了多语言口语场景下安全对齐评测的空白，属于benchmark资产贡献。
summary.technical_approach: 构建包含多语言代码切换的有害语音数据集，额外引入语音混淆机制——在安全关键词周围插入语音合理的伪词模拟局部混淆，量化模型越狱成功率。
summary.experiments: 在多个SOTA大音频语言模型上测试，代码切换有害语音的越狱成功率显著更高，非英单语与非英代码切换对的攻击成功率最高，伪词插入进一步降低模型拒绝率。
summary.authors_note: Mila-魁北克AI研究院、麦吉尔大学团队，无公开知名核心作者。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing safety alignment evaluations for large audio language models (LALMs) only cover monolingual text-based harmful prompts, and lack testing for generalization under multilingual code-switched speech scenarios, as well as verification methods for speech-level obfuscation attacks.
summary_en.importance: Contributes SpeechJBB, the first jailbreak benchmark dataset for LALMs targeting code-switched speech scenarios, filling the gap in safety alignment evaluation for multilingual spoken settings, as a benchmark asset contribution.
summary_en.technical_approach: Constructs a harmful speech dataset with multilingual code-switching, and introduces an additional speech obfuscation mechanism: inserting phonologically plausible pseudo-words around safety-critical terms to simulate local obfuscation, to quantify model jailbreak success rate.
summary_en.experiments: Tested on multiple SOTA LALMs: code-switched harmful speech yields significantly higher jailbreak success rates, with non-English monolingual and non-English code-switched pairs showing the highest attack success; pseudo-word insertion further reduces model refusal rates.
summary_en.authors_note: Team from Mila - Quebec AI Institute and McGill University, no publicly well-known core authors.

recommendation.zh: 做多模态/音频LM安全对齐的研究员可看，重点参考数据集构建的代码切换和伪词混淆设计思路。
recommendation.en: For researchers focused on multimodal/audio LM safety alignment, focus on the code-switching and pseudo-word obfuscation design ideas in dataset construction.

paper.title: SafeGene: Reusable Adapters for Transferable Safety Alignment
paper.abstract: Open-weight LLMs are increasingly fine-tuned into customized assistants, but downstream fine-tuning can weaken safety alignment and make models more vulnerable to malicious prompts, even when the training data is not intentionally harmful. This creates a recurring safety recovery problem as target models are repeatedly updated with new task data or user interactions. We propose SafeGene, a reusable safety-adapter module designed for cross-task reuse within each architecture-compatible model fami

summary.core_problem: 解决开源 LLM 在反复任务微调后安全对齐被削弱、需要反复做安全修复的问题。
summary.importance: 这是一个后训练安全维护问题。贡献点不在新的对齐目标，而在把“安全能力”做成可复用 adapter，尝试从一次次模型级修补转成跨任务迁移的模块化恢复。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 SafeGene，将安全能力表示为与任务更新解耦的可复用 adapter。方法先从“已对齐模型”和“被下游微调后退化的模型”之间提取差异表示，再通过 data-aware 的层选择把这些差异压成可迁移的 safety vectors，最后在新任务模型上用少量样本做逐层系数重校准，以恢复安全行为而尽量少伤任务能力。
summary.experiments: 摘要只说明在多个模型家族上做了跨任务复用实验，关注点是安全恢复、迁移性和少样本重校准成本；但未给出参数规模、数据规模、具体 baseline 和提升幅度。按摘要判断，实验更像后训练安全工程验证，而不是 clean 的预训练结论。

summary_en.core_problem: It addresses the recurring loss of safety alignment after downstream fine-tuning of open-weight LLMs, which otherwise requires repeated safety repair.
summary_en.importance: This is a post-training safety maintenance problem. The contribution is not a new alignment objective, but a modular view that treats safety capability as a reusable adapter transferable across tasks.
summary_en.technical_approach: SafeGene represents safety as a reusable adapter decoupled from task-specific updates. It extracts discrepancy signals between an aligned model and its degraded task-tuned counterpart, refines them into transferable safety vectors via data-aware layer selection, and re-expresses them in new task-adapted models through few-shot layer-wise coefficient recalibration.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract claims experiments across multiple model families, focusing on safety recovery, transferability, and low-shot recalibration cost. However, it does not provide model sizes, data scale, baselines, or effect sizes. From the abstract alone, the setup looks more like post-training safety engineering than a clean pretraining-facing result.

recommendation.zh: 对 pretrain 价值有限，主要是把安全能力模块化；若你关心 pretrain↔post-train 接口，可只看 adapter 提取与层选择，别把它当成通用对齐解法。
recommendation.en: Limited pretraining value; the useful bit is the modularization of safety as a transferable adapter—read the extraction and layer-selection parts, but do not overgeneralize it as a universal alignment fix.

paper.title: Safety Paradox: How Enhanced Safety Awareness Leaves LLMs Vulnerable to Posterior Attack
paper.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are rigorously aligned to refuse harmful requests, a process that inherently cultivates a latent capacity to evaluate and recognize unsafe content. In this work, we reveal that this advanced safety awareness inadvertently introduces a fatal vulnerability. We introduce Posterior Attack, a single-query jailbreak that bypasses guardrails by prompting the model to generate the exact harmful response its internal classifier would normally flag as unsafe. summary.core_problem: 对齐良好的 LLM 具备强大的内部安全判别能力，但这种能力反而可以被利用，通过让模型生成“会被其内部判别器标记为不安全”的回复来绕过安全护栏。
summary.importance: 揭示了 LLM 安全对齐中的一个结构性漏洞（安全悖论）：模型的安全判别能力越强，越容易受到后验攻击（Posterior Attack）。这挑战了现有的安全对齐范式。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Posterior Attack，一种无需搜索的单次查询越狱方法。传统攻击试图最大化生成有害回复的先验概率，而 Posterior Attack 利用模型的评估能力，通过 prompt 引导模型模拟后验概率：生成一个会被其内部安全分类器标记为有害的回复。通过贝叶斯推断形式化了“安全悖论”。
summary.experiments: 在 30 个开源 LLM 和前沿闭源模型（如 GPT-5-Chat, Claude Sonnet 4.6）上进行了评估，发现安全判别准确率与后验攻击成功率呈强正相关。通过 GRPO 强化学习实验证实：人为降低模型的安全判别能力可以免疫该攻击，而提高判别能力则会加剧漏洞。
summary.reading_guide: 重点关注 Posterior Attack 的 prompt 设计思想（Figure 1 和 Table 7）以及 Safety Paradox 的贝叶斯推断解释。预计阅读时间 15 分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Well-aligned LLMs possess strong internal safety judgment capabilities, but this very capability can be exploited to bypass safety guardrails by prompting the model to generate a response that its internal discriminator would flag as unsafe.
summary_en.importance: Reveals a structural vulnerability in LLM safety alignment (the Safety Paradox): the stronger a model's safety judgment capability, the more susceptible it is to Posterior Attack. This challenges current safety alignment paradigms.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes Posterior Attack, a search-free, single-query jailbreak method. While traditional attacks try to maximize the prior probability of generating a harmful response, Posterior Attack exploits the model's evaluative capacity by prompting it to simulate the posterior probability: generating a response that its internal safety classifier would flag as harmful. Formalizes the 'Safety Paradox' using Bayesian inference.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated across 30 open-source LLMs and frontier closed-source models (e.g., GPT-5-Chat, Claude Sonnet 4.6), finding a strong positive correlation between safety-judgment accuracy and posterior attack success rate. Confirmed via GRPO reinforcement learning experiments that artificially degrading a model's safety judgment immunizes it against the attack, while enhancing it exacerbates the vulnerability.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the prompt design philosophy of Posterior Attack (Figure 1 and Table 7) and the Bayesian inference explanation of the Safety Paradox. Estimated reading time: 15 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 对齐阶段的反常识发现，做安全预训练/RLHF的必须看§4的因果验证部分，警惕对齐的副作用
recommendation.en: Counterintuitive finding in alignment; safety pretrain/RLHF researchers must read §4 for causal validation of alignment side effects

paper.title: Willing but Unable: Separating Refusal from Capability in Code LLMs via Abliteration
paper.abstract: Producing a labeled vulnerable code at scale is a recurring obstacle for learning-based vulnerability detection: mined corpora carry substantial label noise, and existing LLM-based augmentation propagates these inaccuracies because it transforms vulnerable seeds rather than synthesising vulnerabilities from a specification. A complementary route is to start from safe code and ask an instruction-tuned LLM to inject a specified CWE (which would shift the labeling burden from open-ended detection t

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文研究的核心不是漏洞检测本身，而是一个更一般的模型行为分解问题：当安全对齐过的 code LLM 拒绝执行“注入某类漏洞”的指令时，拒绝到底是因为模型不会做，还是因为模型会做但被 refusal policy 截断了。作者用 abliteration 这个低秩权重编辑方法，尝试把 residual stream 中的 refusal direction 投影掉，从而把“愿不愿意做”和“有没有能力做”拆开测量。任务上选的是 Python 代码中的 CWE-89 SQL injection 注入，目的是验证：去掉拒绝后，模型是否真的能按规范把安全代码改成带指定漏洞的代码。
summary.importance: 从预训练研究视角，这篇工作的直接相关性不算高，因为主任务是安全与代码数据构造，不是基座训练本身。但它有两个值得注意的接口。第一，它提供了一个很干净的 post-train 行为分解案例：alignment policy 可以遮蔽底层能力，去掉 policy 后暴露出的性能差异仍然主要受模型容量约束。这对理解 RLHF / instruction tuning 与 base capability 的关系有参考价值。第二，它把“refusal”和“capability”当成近似正交轴来测，而不是把 compliance 当单一指标，这种测量框架对研究对齐信号如何覆盖或扭曲预训练能力是有启发的。贡献量级上，它更像一篇小规模 feasibility study，而不是会改变代码 LLM 训练范式的工作。
summary.technical_approach:
方法分三段。第一段是 prompt construction：从经静态分析确认不含某类漏洞的安全代码出发，显式要求模型施加某个 CWE 特定变换，生成带目标漏洞的版本。作者强调这种构造改变了标注问题的形态：不再是对真实世界样本做开放式多类漏洞识别，而是对“我指定要注入 CWE-X”的输出做二元确认，负例可以直接过滤。第二段是 refusal removal via abliteration。作者选用 Qwen2.5-Coder-Instruct 3B、7B、14B 三个开源尺寸，对模型做低秩编辑，核心思想是识别出与 refusal 行为相关的方向，并在残差流中正交投影掉，让模型不再被这条对齐策略短路。第三段是 validation：用三个独立静态分析器 CodeQL、Semgrep、Bandit 做集成验证，再对 detector-positive 样本做作者人工裁决，避免单一工具误报直接当成成功注入。

全文里比较重要的判断是，作者并不把 abliteration 当成“解锁隐藏能力的万能钥匙”。他们明确把安全对齐模型在这类提示上的行为拆成两个子任务：识别这是不该执行的请求，以及知道如何完成代码变换。abliteration 只针对前者，不会凭空创造后者。因此实验设计是一个 3×2 因子：不同模型规模 × 是否 abliterate，用来观察 refusal 降低后，剩余差异是否仍由能力主导。这个 framing 比单纯比较 jailbreak 成功率更干净，也更接近可分析的训练接口问题。
summary.experiments:
实验对象是 Qwen2.5-Coder-Instruct 3B、7B、14B，任务是 Python 上的 CWE-89 SQL injection 注入。作者选择这个家族有三个原因：需要开放权重以便做权重编辑；需要代码专长模型；还希望在低资源环境下可复现，因此选了可 CPU 推理的尺寸。核心结果是标题里的结论：willing but unable。abliteration 可以把 refusal 降到零或接近零，但成功注入漏洞的能力并不会因此自动出现，且不同规模之间仍有明显能力差。作者在引言里给出的最关键数字是：即便在两端模型都已把 refusal 基本清除后，3B 和 7B 之间在漏洞注入成功率上仍有约 50 个百分点差距。这说明 compliance 的瓶颈在较小模型上不是 refusal，而是 transformation capability 本身不足。

另一个实验贡献是验证流程比较严谨。作者没有把模型自述或单一静态分析器命中当成成功，而是采用三工具集成，再对阳性样本人工复核。这一点很重要，因为漏洞注入任务很容易被表面字符串模式或不完整污点路径误导。论文片段没有给出完整结果表，因此无法可靠复述各尺寸在原始 refusal rate、abliterated refusal rate、validator-positive rate 上的全部数字；但从正文可确认，尺度效应是主结论，且 refusal removal 与 capability gain 并不等价。
summary.reading_guide:
这篇适合带着“post-train 行为分解”去看，而不是把它当安全论文细节逐项追。先看 Introduction，抓住作者为什么认为现有漏洞数据构造有结构性噪声，以及为什么要把问题改写成从安全代码定向注入 CWE。然后看 Approach，重点理解三阶段 pipeline，尤其是 abliteration 在这里被假设只移除 refusal policy，而不改变代码变换知识。实验部分优先看 3×2 因子设计和各尺寸在 refusal 与 injection success 上的分离趋势，再看 validation protocol，确认作者如何避免把误报当成功。最后再看 threats to validity 和 ethical statement，这两部分对理解结果边界很关键。

如果只是泛读，20–30 分钟足够：Introduction、方法图、主结果表、验证流程。若想深一点，可以追两个问题：一是 refusal direction 的提取是否会顺带破坏其他有用行为；二是“能力不足”究竟来自代码知识、长程编辑能力，还是 instruction following 的细粒度控制不足。论文把它们合并成 capability，但没有进一步拆开。
summary.authors_note: 正文可确认作者来自 dessertlab，配套评测仓库为 AblitEval（github.com/dessertlab/AblitEval）。当前片段未给出完整作者名单与机构全称，无法可靠补全。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies a clean behavioral decomposition question in code LLMs: when a safety-aligned model refuses a prompt that asks it to inject a specific vulnerability, is the failure due to lack of capability or due to a refusal policy that blocks an otherwise available capability? The authors use abliteration, a low-rank weight edit that projects out a refusal direction in the residual stream, to separate those two factors. The concrete task is Python code transformation for CWE-89 SQL injection, starting from code that static analysis deems safe and asking the model to produce a vulnerable variant.
summary_en.importance: Its direct relevance to pretraining is limited, since the paper is mainly about safety behavior and synthetic vulnerability generation rather than foundation-model training. Still, it has two useful interfaces with core LLM research. First, it offers a controlled example of how post-training alignment can mask underlying capability. Removing the refusal behavior does not erase scale-dependent performance gaps, which is informative for thinking about the relationship between RLHF-style policies and base-model competence. Second, the paper treats refusal and capability as separate axes rather than collapsing them into a single compliance score. That measurement framing is useful for studying how alignment signals overlay, suppress, or distort pretrained abilities. The contribution is best read as a feasibility study, not as a new paradigm for code LMs.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The pipeline has three stages. Stage one is prompt construction: start from code that a static analyzer confirms is not vulnerable to a target CWE, then ask the model to apply a CWE-specific transformation and generate a vulnerable counterpart. The point is to change the labeling problem. Instead of open-ended vulnerability detection on noisy real-world corpora, the validator only needs to answer a bounded binary question about whether the intended weakness was successfully introduced. Stage two is refusal removal via abliteration. The authors edit Qwen2.5-Coder-Instruct models at 3B, 7B, and 14B by identifying a refusal-related direction and orthogonally projecting it out of the residual stream. The intended effect is to remove the policy that short-circuits the response while preserving whatever code-transformation knowledge the model already has. Stage three is validation: outputs are checked by an ensemble of three static analyzers—CodeQL, Semgrep, and Bandit—and detector-positive cases are manually adjudicated by the authors.

The paper’s main conceptual move is to decompose behavior into two subproblems: recognizing that the request should be refused, and knowing how to perform the requested transformation. Abliteration is only meant to remove the first. It is not supposed to create the second. That is why the experimental design is a controlled 3×2 factorial over model scale and abliteration status. This framing is more informative than a generic jailbreak success rate because it lets the authors ask whether compliance after refusal removal is still capacity-bound.
summary_en.experiments:
The experiments use Qwen2.5-Coder-Instruct 3B, 7B, and 14B on Python CWE-89 SQL injection. The family is chosen because the weights are open, the models are code-specialized, and the selected sizes remain reproducible in low-resource settings. The headline result is exactly the one in the title: willing but unable. Abliteration can drive refusal to zero or near zero, but successful vulnerability injection remains strongly scale-dependent. The most important number stated in the paper is a roughly 50-point gap in post-abliteration injection success between the 3B and 7B models, even after refusal has been largely eliminated for both. That supports the claim that willingness and capability are orthogonal: removing refusal unlocks capability that is already present, but it does not manufacture capability that is missing.

Another strength is the validation protocol. The authors do not count model self-reports or a single analyzer hit as success. They use three independent tools and then manually review detector-positive outputs, which matters because vulnerability injection can be overestimated by superficial lexical cues or incomplete static-analysis paths. The provided excerpt does not include the full result tables, so exact refusal rates and validator-positive rates for every model condition are not recoverable here. But the qualitative pattern is clear from the full text fragment: scale remains the dominant factor once refusal is removed.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Read this as a paper about disentangling post-training behavior, not primarily as a security benchmark paper. Start with the introduction to understand why the authors view existing vulnerability datasets as structurally noisy and why they reformulate the problem as targeted CWE injection from safe code. Then read the approach section carefully, especially the assumption that abliteration removes refusal policy without adding transformation knowledge. In the experiments, focus on the 3×2 design and on the separation between refusal reduction and injection success. After that, inspect the validation protocol, since much of the paper’s credibility depends on not mistaking analyzer artifacts for true vulnerability insertion. The threats-to-validity and ethics sections are also worth reading because they define the limits of what can be concluded.

For a skim, 20–30 minutes is enough for the introduction, method figure, main results, and validation setup. For a deeper read, two questions are worth pursuing: whether the extracted refusal direction also removes other useful behaviors, and what exactly sits inside the residual category called capability—code knowledge, long-range editing skill, or fine-grained instruction control. The paper treats those jointly rather than separating them further.
summary_en.authors_note: The text identifies the release repository as AblitEval under dessertlab (github.com/dessertlab/AblitEval). The provided excerpt does not include a reliable full author list or full institutional names.

recommendation.zh: abliteration在代码模型上解耦拒绝与生成能力的实证，可作为内部对齐方向ablation的参考，仅看实验结果部分即可。
recommendation.en: Empirical validation of abliteration decoupling refusal and generation in code LLMs; reference for internal alignment ablations, only read experiment results.

paper.title: CHASE: Adversarial Red-Blue Teaming for Improving LLM Safety using Reinforcement Learning
paper.abstract: Despite advances in safety alignment, prompt-rewriting attacks such as persona modulation, fictional framing and persuasion-based reformulation, can bypass safety filters even on frontier models. Existing defenses either rely on non-scalable human curation or white-box optimisation that overfits to specific model internals, leaving aligned models brittle against the very class of adaptive black-box adversaries they will face in deployment. To address this gap, we introduce CHASE (Co-evolutionary

summary.core_problem: 解决安全对齐模型容易被黑盒提示改写攻击绕过的问题，尤其是人格扮演、虚构包装和说服式重写这类部署中常见攻击。
summary.importance: 这是一个后训练安全强化工作，贡献点在于把红队攻击者和蓝队防御者放进闭环共进化流程，而不是依赖人工收集越狱样本或白盒优化。对预训练研究员的价值主要在于：它提供了一个观察 RL 对安全边界塑形方式的实验框架，但不直接推进基座预训练方法。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 CHASE 框架。攻击者端用 GRPO 训练黑盒重写器，奖励采用乘法形式，同时约束绕过成功率和原始有害意图保持；防御者端把收集到的对抗改写样本用于两阶段加固：先 GRPO，再结合 rejection-sampled SFT，并与良性数据混合以减轻过拒。整体是红蓝双方交替升级的 closed-loop adversarial training。
summary.experiments: 摘要显示在 Beaver 系列安全评测上验证，但给出的实验细节不完整；可确认的核心比较对象包括现有安全对齐模型、人工或静态越狱集训练的防御方案，以及不同上下游攻击设置。主要结论是共进化训练能提升对黑盒提示改写攻击的鲁棒性，同时保持对 benign 数据的平衡。是否有显著泛化、是否过拟合到特定攻击模板，需要看正文中的 held-out attack family 设计。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 University of New South Wales。不是头部实验室安全技术报告，更像一篇方法型学术论文。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a practical safety failure mode: aligned LLMs can still be bypassed by black-box prompt rewriting attacks such as persona modulation, fictional framing, and persuasion-style reformulations.
summary_en.importance: This is a post-training safety hardening paper. Its main contribution is a closed-loop co-evolution setup between attacker and defender, instead of relying on manually curated jailbreak data or white-box optimization. For pretraining researchers, the value is indirect: it offers a concrete RL-based framework for studying how safety boundaries are reshaped under adversarial pressure.
summary_en.technical_approach: CHASE trains a black-box attacker with GRPO using a multiplicative reward that jointly enforces jailbreak success and intent preservation. The defender is then hardened on harvested adversarial rewrites with a two-stage pipeline: GRPO followed by rejection-sampled SFT, balanced with benign data to control over-refusal. The overall system alternates red-team escalation and blue-team hardening.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract mentions evaluation on Beaver-style safety benchmarks, but the exact setup is truncated. The likely baselines include standard aligned models, static adversarial training, and non-co-evolutionary defenses. The headline claim is improved robustness to adaptive black-box prompt rewriting while preserving benign behavior. The real question is whether the gains transfer to held-out attack families rather than overfitting to the attacker policy.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from the University of New South Wales. This does not appear to be a major frontier-lab technical report; it reads as an academic methods paper.

recommendation.zh: 可当作 RL 安全闭环训练的一个样例看，但离基座预训练较远；先看攻击奖励设计和 held-out attack 泛化，别被安全分数表面提升带偏。
recommendation.en: Useful as a case study of RL-based safety co-training, but far from core pretraining; check the reward design and held-out attack transfer before trusting the gains.

paper.title: Domain-Conditioned Safety in Frontier Computer-Using Agents: A 793-Episode Browser Benchmark, a Coding-Domain Cross-Reference, and a Reproducibility Audit of Recent Red-Teaming
paper.abstract: Recent computer-using-agent (CUA) red-teaming papers report prompt-injection attack success rates (ASR) of 42-98%, but these headline numbers cluster on retired models and on the most-vulnerable model in each paper's panel. We ask whether those techniques, reproduced as hand-crafted templates, still work against current frontier CUAs. We release CUA-HandCrafted, a public benchmark of 793 episodes spanning 24 multi-step web tasks, 56 attack templates, 8 attack families, and 4 system-prompt config

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要回答两个很实际的问题：近一年 CUA prompt injection 论文里常见的高攻击成功率，放到当前 frontier browser agents 上还能不能复现；以及“agent 安全性”是不是一个可跨工具域泛化的统一属性。作者用一个 793 episode 的浏览器基准，把 RL-Hammer、WASP、TRAP、MUZZLE 等工作里描述过的攻击技巧手工模板化，在 Claude Sonnet 4.6 和 GPT-5.4 上重新测量，并进一步对照同权重模型在 coding-agent 场景下的表现。
summary.importance: 对预训练本身帮助不大，但对 post-train、安全评测和 agent 训练信号质量有现实意义。它最有价值的结论不是“前沿模型已经安全”，而是两点更细的判断：第一，文献里很多高 ASR 结果依赖 RL 优化出来的具体 phrasing，而不是攻击类别本身；如果不公开优化字符串，结果很难复现。第二，安全强化是强 domain-conditioned 的，同一组权重在 browser 工具域上几乎免疫手工注入，在 coding-agent 域却可能大幅失守。对做基座和后训练的人，这意味着安全能力不能被当成单一标量，也不能只靠一个工具域的红队结果外推到别的 agent 形态。
summary.technical_approach:
方法上，作者构建了一个公开的 CUA-HandCrafted benchmark。它不是再做一个自动攻击器，而是把已有红队论文中的攻击方法按 prose description 手工转写成可执行模板，放进统一浏览器环境里评测。基准包含 793 个 episode、24 个多步网页任务、56 个攻击模板、8 个攻击家族、5 个攻击深度、4 种 system prompt 配置，并使用 screenshot+a11y 的混合感知。评测指标兼容 AgentDojo 风格的 BU/UuA/ASR/Safety 指标。

设计上最关键的地方有三处。第一，作者刻意区分“技术类别”与“优化 phrasing”。他们不做 RL 搜索，而是只测人类可读、可公开复现的模板，因此测到的是 technique floor，而不是 RL-optimized ceiling。第二，他们做 prompt ablation，把 system prompt 从较强防护版本逐步削到 L0_bare 和 L1_helpful，检查抗攻击性是否仍存在，以判断防护主要来自 prompt 还是模型权重。第三，他们做跨域对照：同样的 frontier 权重，一边放在 browser benchmark，一边放在 coding-agent 的 SkillBench 上，直接测 domain transfer 是否成立。

此外，作者还补了两个边界实验。一个是小预算 RL attacker 上界：在同一 harness 里跑 AutoInject 式 adaptive-random-suffix RL baseline，限定 5 query/pair 和约 10 美元预算，测在这个预算下 RL 是否已经能打开缺口。另一个是 image-channel replication，复现实验性地检查 popup overlay 和页面内恶意文本这两类视觉/图文混合注入在 frontier 模型上是否仍有效。

和已有工作相比，这篇的创新不在攻击算法，而在评测设计和复现审计。它把“旧论文 headline ASR 很高”拆成了几个更可检验的因素：目标模型是否已退役、优化字符串是否公开、手工近似是否还能生效、以及成功是否只局限在某个工具域。
summary.experiments:
核心结果很明确。浏览器域上，在 793 个 episode 的总基准中，针对 Sonnet 4.6 和 GPT-5.4，作者报告多步攻击成功为 0/140；按 Clopper–Pearson 95% 置信上界，ASR 上界约为 2.60%。原始记录里有 2/158 的表面成功，但都出现在 bank_check_balance 任务，且被归因为实验期间 ground-truth balance 变化，不计为有效成功。对 RL-Hammer、WASP、TRAP、MUZZLE 等 headline 技术的手工复现，在 frontier 模型上 Phase 9 为 0/40。更关键的是，即便把 system prompt 削弱到 L0_bare 和 L1_helpful，这些攻击仍然是 0% ASR，因此作者判断当前 browser-domain 的抗注入能力主要在权重里，而不是靠外层 prompt 包装。

但这种安全性不泛化。放到 coding-agent 的 SkillBench 上，同样的 Sonnet 4.6 和 GPT-5.4 对手工 skill-injection 明显脆弱：Sonnet 4.6 最高可到 40/40=100%，GPT-5.4 可到 79/100=79%，跨方法均值分别为 33.3% 和 66.8%。这说明 Anthropic system card 里 Sonnet 4.5→4.6 的大幅 ASR 下降，只能说明 browser 域强化有效，不能推出“模型整体 agent 安全性”同步提升。

复现审计部分也很有信息量。作者检查了 RL-Hammer、WASP、TRAP、RedTeamCUA、MUZZLE、pop-ups 等工作，记录目标模型是否仍可 API 访问、优化字符串是否公开、以及在最接近的 frontier successor 上手工复现的 ASR。结论是 6 篇里有 4 篇同时满足“目标模型已退役 + 优化字符串未公开”，这使得 headline 结果难以独立验证。

边界实验方面，AutoInject 风格 RL baseline 在 5-query/pair、约 10 美元预算下，对 Sonnet 4.6 和 GPT-5.4 仍是 0/100，说明至少在这个小预算区间内，RL gap 还没有被打开。图像通道复现里，popup-overlay 类在 frontier 上只有 1/30=3.3% attempted-compromise，而页面内恶意文本 fixture 仍有 5/20=25%，但多数被 harness 的登录墙限制在导航到 exfiltration 之前。这进一步说明“图像通道”也不是统一结论，不同载体的攻击面差异很大。
summary.reading_guide:
如果只想抓住结论，先看 Introduction 和 Section 3。这里已经把最关键的数字给全了：browser 0/140、coding 最高 100%/79%、prompt ablation 后仍 0%、小预算 RL 仍 0/100。读到这里就能明白作者真正想修正的是文献解读方式，而不是单纯给出一个新 benchmark。

然后看 benchmark 设计部分，重点看 attack template 是如何从原论文 prose 转写的，哪些地方属于“忠实复现”，哪些地方不可避免要做人工补全。因为整篇工作的说服力建立在这个边界上：它测的是 hand-crafted reproducibility，不是原论文 RL attacker 的理论上限。

接着看 Section 5 的 browser-vs-coding 对照实验。这部分最值得细读，因为它直接支持 domain-conditioned safety 的主张。要看同权重、同类攻击思想、不同工具域下，为什么 coding 面更脆弱；如果文中给了失败案例或 action trace，建议看几条具体轨迹。

最后看 Section 6 和相关表格，尤其是复现审计表。这里能快速判断哪些文献 headline 结果因为模型退役或字符串未公开而难以验证。若做 agent safety eval，这部分比单个 ASR 数字更有方法论意义。

整体属于泛读型论文。读主文 30–40 分钟足够抓住主线；若要复现实验，再看附录里的环境、模板和判分细节。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses two practical questions. First, do the high prompt-injection success rates reported in recent computer-using-agent red-teaming papers still reproduce on current frontier browser agents? Second, is agent safety a single transferable property, or is it strongly domain-specific? To answer this, the authors build a 793-episode browser benchmark, handcraft attack templates from prior papers, evaluate them on Claude Sonnet 4.6 and GPT-5.4, and then compare the same model weights in a coding-agent setting.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining paper, but it matters for post-training, safety evaluation, and how we interpret agent hardening. The main value is not a claim that frontier agents are broadly safe. The more useful conclusion is narrower: much of the literature’s high ASR appears to depend on RL-optimized phrasing rather than the attack category alone, and safety improvements are highly domain-conditioned. A model that is robust to hand-crafted browser injection may still be highly vulnerable in a coding-agent environment. For foundation-model researchers, that means safety should not be treated as a single scalar capability, and evidence from one tool domain should not be overgeneralized to another.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The core artifact is CUA-HandCrafted, a public benchmark designed for reproducible evaluation rather than for maximizing attack strength. The benchmark contains 793 episodes, 24 multi-step web tasks, 56 attack templates, 8 attack families, 5 depth levels, and 4 system-prompt configurations, with hybrid screenshot plus accessibility-tree perception. Metrics are aligned with AgentDojo-style BU, UuA, ASR, and safety measurements.

The methodological choice that matters most is the separation between attack technique and optimized phrasing. Instead of training a new attacker, the authors manually transcribe attack methods from prior red-teaming papers into human-readable templates. This means the benchmark measures a reproducible hand-crafted floor, not the full ceiling of RL-discovered attacks. They then run prompt ablations down to L0_bare and L1_helpful to test whether resistance comes from the system prompt or from the model weights. Finally, they perform a domain-transfer check by evaluating the same frontier weights in a coding-agent harness, SkillBench, under analogous skill-injection setups.

The paper also includes two useful boundary checks. One is a small-budget RL attacker baseline, AutoInject-style adaptive random suffix search, to estimate whether RL can recover a gap under a constrained query and cost budget. The other is an image-channel replication that tests popup-overlay and in-content malicious-text attacks on frontier models. These additions help distinguish between “hand-crafted attacks fail” and “the attack surface is closed.”

Compared with prior work, the contribution is not a new attack algorithm. It is a reproducibility-oriented evaluation design plus an audit of what recent headline ASRs actually depend on: retired target models, unreleased optimized strings, and domain-specific hardening.
summary_en.experiments:
The main browser-domain result is straightforward. Across the benchmark, the authors report 0/140 successful multi-step attacks on Claude Sonnet 4.6 and GPT-5.4, with a Clopper–Pearson 95% upper bound of about 2.60% on ASR. There were 2 apparent successes out of 158 raw episodes, but both occurred on a bank-balance task where the ground truth changed during the experiment, so they were excluded as invalid. Hand-crafted reproductions of RL-Hammer, WASP, TRAP, and MUZZLE-style attacks also score 0/40 on frontier models. Importantly, this remains true under prompt ablations down to L0_bare and L1_helpful, which supports the claim that browser-domain resistance is primarily in the weights rather than in a defensive system prompt wrapper.

That robustness does not transfer to coding agents. On SkillBench, the same model weights are highly vulnerable to hand-crafted skill injection: Sonnet 4.6 reaches up to 40/40 = 100% ASR, GPT-5.4 up to 79/100 = 79%, with cross-method means of 33.3% and 66.8%, respectively. This is the paper’s most important empirical point. The large Sonnet 4.5 to 4.6 improvement documented in Anthropic’s browser-agent system card should therefore be read as browser-specific hardening, not as a general agent-safety improvement.

The reproducibility audit is also informative. For RL-Hammer, WASP, TRAP, RedTeamCUA, MUZZLE, and pop-ups, the authors record whether the original target model is still accessible, whether the optimized attack strings were released, and what ASR their hand-crafted approximations achieve on the closest frontier successor. Four of the six audited papers fall into the combination of retired target plus unreleased strings, which makes independent reproduction difficult.

The boundary experiments reinforce the same story. A within-harness AutoInject-style RL baseline achieves 0/100 on Sonnet 4.6 and GPT-5.4 under a 5-query-per-pair budget and roughly $10 of API spend, so at least under that budget the RL gap is not opened. In the image-channel replication, popup-overlay attacks drop to 1/30 = 3.3% attempted compromise on frontier models, while in-content malicious-text fixtures still reach 5/20 = 25%, though many are bounded by harness login walls before exfiltration. So even within the visual channel, attackability is not uniform.
summary_en.reading_guide:
If you only want the main conclusions, read the introduction and Section 3 first. The key numbers are already there: 0/140 on browser tasks, strong failures on coding tasks, 0% even after prompt ablation, and 0/100 for the small-budget RL baseline. That is enough to understand the paper’s central claim about reproducibility and domain-conditioned safety.

Then read the benchmark construction section. Focus on how attack templates were transcribed from prior papers, what counts as a faithful reproduction, and where manual interpretation was unavoidable. The credibility of the whole paper depends on this boundary, because the benchmark is intentionally measuring reproducible hand-crafted attacks rather than the full power of optimized attackers.

Next, read the browser-versus-coding comparison in detail. This is the strongest part of the paper. It directly tests whether safety hardening transfers across tool domains on the same weights. If the paper includes action traces or failure examples, those are worth inspecting because they often reveal whether the coding failures come from instruction-following bias, tool-surface differences, or weaker domain-specific refusal behavior.

Finally, read the reproducibility audit table in Section 6. It is useful beyond this paper because it helps interpret prior headline ASRs in terms of model availability and release practices. For someone working on agent safety evaluation, that table is more methodologically important than any single ASR number.

This is a skim paper. About 30–40 minutes on the main text is enough to capture the argument. Read the appendices only if you want to reproduce the environment or inspect the exact templates and scoring rules.

recommendation.zh: 揭示了模型安全性（抗注入能力）高度依赖于领域（浏览器 vs 代码），说明前沿模型的 safety alignment 泛化性存在严重缺陷，对 post-training 数据配比有直接启示。
recommendation.en: Reveals that model safety (injection resistance) is highly domain-dependent (browser vs. coding), highlighting severe generalization flaws in frontier models' safety alignment, which directly informs post-training data mixing.

Adaptive steering methods like AdaSteer and CAST inherit this failure cross-lingually. We diagnose where transfer breaks down.
