summary.core_problem: 高资源语言中学到的安全对齐在低资源语言中迁移效果差（如Swahili/Burmese），诊断这种跨语言安全失效发生在模型内部哪一层。
summary.importance: 机制分析+方法贡献——首次定位跨语言安全失效的具体层面：表征已存在但安全决策校准失败；提出仅用1-4个目标语言样本重新校准即可恢复拒绝率，无需重新训练。
summary.technical_approach: 在三个模型（Qwen2.5-7B、Gemma-2-9B、Llama-3.1-8B）和23种语言上进行诊断实验：测量高资源语言激活中提取的危害性方向在低资源语言中的线性可分性，对比表征与决策行为的差异。提出低秩logistic读出+决策阈值重置的重校准方法。
summary.experiments: 高资源激活提取的危害性方向在低资源提示上几乎与高资源同样好地线性分离有害/无害样本（表征存在），但有害拒绝率从87.9%降至43.9%（行动失败）。用1-4个目标语言样本重校准即可恢复安全行为。
summary.authors_note: Mohamed bin Zayed University of Artificial Intelligence（MBZUAI），Fajri Koto是该领域较为活跃的研究者。

summary_en.core_problem: Safety alignment learned in high-resource languages transfers poorly to low-resource languages (e.g., Swahili, Burmese); the paper diagnoses at which internal level this cross-lingual safety failure occurs.
summary_en.importance: Mechanism diagnosis + method contribution — first to pinpoint the level of cross-lingual safety failure: representation exists but safety decision calibration fails; proposes recalibration with as few as 1-4 target-language samples, no retraining needed.
summary_en.technical_approach: Diagnostic experiments across three models (Qwen2.5-7B, Gemma-2-9B, Llama-3.1-8B) and 23 languages: measures linear separability of harmful vs. harmless low-resource prompts using harmfulness directions extracted from high-resource activations, compares representation vs. behavioral gaps. Proposes low-rank logistic readout with decision threshold reset as recalibration.
summary_en.experiments: Harmfulness direction from high-resource activations linearly separates low-resource harmful/harmless prompts nearly as well as high-resource (representation present), but refusal rate drops from 87.9% to 43.9% (action failure). Recalibration with 1-4 target-language samples restores safety behavior.
summary_en.authors_note: Mohamed bin Zayed University of Artificial Intelligence (MBZUAI); Fajri Koto is an active researcher in this area.

recommendation.zh: 跨语言安全对齐的核心发现对后训练有直接启示：表征迁移成功但决策校准失败，说明低资源对齐可以极低成本修复。重校准方法值得在内部alignment pipeline中验证。
recommendation.en: Core finding — representation transfers successfully but decision calibration fails — has direct implications for post-training; low-resource safety fixable at extreme low cost. Worth verifying in internal alignment pipelines.

paper.title: SafeSteer: Localized On-Policy Distillation for Efficient Safety Alignment

summary.core_problem: SafeSteer 处理的是安全对齐中的 alignment tax：常规 SFT/RLHF/DPO 类方法会在全词表、全分布上施加训练信号，安全能力提升时容易牵动通用能力。论文的核心假设是，拒答和安全相关特征在输出分布中是稀疏的，因此对齐不应被建模成全局能力权衡，而应尽量只改动与安全行为直接相关的 token 区域。
summary.importance: 这篇论文对预训练研究的直接贡献不大，但对 pretrain-posttrain 接口有启发。它把对齐退化问题具体化为“训练信号作用范围过宽”，而不是简单归因于数据不够或 reward 设计不佳。值得关注的是两点：第一，用 activation steering 构造 self-teacher，减少对更强教师模型和 reward model 的依赖；第二，把 KL 正则限制到安全 token 子集，提供了一种更局部的分布编辑思路。这类方法可以作为持续预训练、能力修补、安全 patching 的轻量范式参考。
summary.technical_approach: 方法分两步。先从基座模型中提取 refusal direction：比较模型在 harmful 与 harmless 指令上的隐藏表示，得到一个拒答方向，并在指定 Transformer 层的 residual stream 中注入该方向，形成 safety teacher。这个 teacher 会稳定地产生拒答信号，甚至会拒绝 harmless prompt；论文利用这一点来挖掘安全 token，而不是直接把它作为最终模型。随后，模型在 Alpaca harmless 指令上采样 teacher 的拒答轨迹，并与原始基座模型的输出分布做对比。论文没有简单选择 logit 差最大的 token，而是用 contrastive log probability 加 voting aggregation 来得到更稳定的安全 token 子集。训练阶段只用 100 条 PKU-SafeRLHF harmful prompt，让 student on-policy 采样响应，并仅在安全 token 子集上施加 reverse KL distillation。这样做的关键区别是：它不混入大规模通用数据，不训练额外 reward model，也不做安全梯度与通用能力梯度的正交投影，而是直接缩小蒸馏损失的支持集。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 4 个模型、7 个安全 benchmark 和 5 个通用能力 benchmark。论文报告 SafeSteer 在安全评测上优于若干已有安全对齐基线，同时通用能力下降较小。数据效率是主要实验点：OPD 阶段只使用 100 条 harmful 样本，作者称数据量低于此前基线的 1%。从给出的全文片段看，具体每个 benchmark 的分数、模型规模、消融数字没有完整展开；已有信息支持的结论是，安全 token 限域 KL、activation-steered teacher、voting 式 token selection 是主要有效组件。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 20–30 分钟。重点看 Method 中三处：refusal direction 如何抽取和注入；safety token subset 如何由 teacher/base 分布对比得到；restricted reverse KL 的具体形式。实验部分优先看安全-通用能力 trade-off 曲线、token selection 消融、训练样本量消融。如果只关心预训练，可跳过大部分安全 benchmark 细节，重点思考这种“稀疏分布编辑”能否迁移到 domain patch、continual pretrain 或能力修复。

summary_en.core_problem: SafeSteer targets the alignment tax in safety tuning. Standard alignment objectives tend to apply supervision over the full output distribution, so improving refusal behavior can perturb general capabilities. The paper’s central assumption is that safety behavior is sparse in token space, and alignment should therefore make localized changes rather than optimize a global safety-versus-capability trade-off.
summary_en.importance: The paper is not a pretraining method, but it is relevant to the pretrain-posttrain interface. It frames capability degradation as a support-size problem of the training signal: the loss touches too many tokens. Two ideas are useful beyond safety alignment: constructing a self-teacher through activation steering, and restricting KL distillation to a mined subset of behavior-specific tokens. This is a lightweight pattern for model patching, continual updates, and narrow behavioral edits without large auxiliary data mixtures.
summary_en.technical_approach: SafeSteer has two main stages. First, it builds a safety teacher from the base model itself. Following refusal-direction work, it contrasts hidden states on harmful and harmless instructions, extracts a refusal direction, and injects that vector into the residual stream at a chosen Transformer layer. The resulting teacher produces stable refusal-like outputs, including on harmless prompts. The method then uses teacher rollouts on Alpaca harmless instructions and contrasts the teacher distribution with the original base-model distribution. Instead of selecting tokens with the largest raw logit gaps, it aggregates contrastive log-probability evidence with a voting scheme to obtain a sparse safety-token set. During training, the student samples on-policy responses to harmful prompts from PKU-SafeRLHF, and the reverse-KL distillation penalty is applied only on that safety-token subset. The method avoids a stronger external teacher, a reward model, large general-purpose replay data, and gradient projection machinery.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments cover four models, seven safety benchmarks, and five general-capability benchmarks. The reported pattern is improved safety with limited degradation on general tasks. The main efficiency claim is that the on-policy distillation stage uses only 100 harmful samples, less than 1% of the data volume used by prior baselines according to the authors. The provided text does not expose the full per-benchmark table or exact model-size breakdown, so the most reliable experimental takeaway is the ablation-level message: activation-steered teaching, safety-token mining, and restricted reverse KL are the key components.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in 20–30 minutes. Focus on the method details for refusal-direction extraction and injection, the safety-token mining algorithm, and the exact restricted reverse-KL objective. In the experiments, prioritize the safety-versus-general-capability trade-off plots, token-selection ablations, and data-size ablations. Readers mainly interested in pretraining can skip most benchmark-specific safety discussion and examine whether sparse distribution editing can transfer to domain repair, continual pretraining, or capability-preserving patching.

recommendation.zh: 这类工作真正有用的地方不在“更安全”，而在它是否证明安全信号可以局部注入而不污染通用分布；先看成本-能力折中表，再决定要不要细读。
recommendation.en: The useful question here is not whether it is 'safer' but whether safety can be injected locally without contaminating the general distribution; read the cost-vs-utility tables first.

paper.title: MESA: Improving MoE Safety Alignment via Decentralized Expertise

summary.core_problem: MoE大模型存在安全稀疏性问题：安全能力集中在少数专家中，攻击者可通过操纵路由激活未对齐的专家，绕过安全防护；同时传统全参数对齐方法会破坏专家专业化特性、扰乱路由分布，带来安全提升与通用能力下降的两难问题。
summary.importance: 首次从架构感知的资源分配视角解决MoE安全对齐问题，提出的安全能力分散化思路，也为MoE预训练、持续训练中的能力分配、路由优化提供了参考，可避免全参数微调对已有专业能力的破坏。
summary.technical_approach: 提出MESA框架，包含两个协同模块：1）专家容量重分配：基于最优传输（OT）理论，通过带KL正则的Sinkhorn算法计算传输成本矩阵，选择最适合承载安全能力的专家群体，最小化安全提升与通用能力损失的权衡；2）动态路由精炼：训练时加入在线OT约束，引导路由将安全相关流量导向调整后的安全专家，同时保留原有通用任务的激活分布。
summary.experiments: 在DeepSeek-V2-Lite上测试：对抗越狱基准Strata的安全得分达90.90%，优于标准SFT（77.70%）、MoE专用方法SafeX（64.00%）以及之前领先的内容级方法Stair-DPO（83.60%）；通用能力上GSM8K得分66.11%，远高于标准SFT（16.15%）和Stair-DPO（15.54%），实现安全提升的同时无显著通用效用损失。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读先看引言部分的安全稀疏性问题定义，再了解两个核心模块的设计逻辑，重点关注最优传输在MoE专家分配中的应用方式，预计阅读时间20-25分钟；关注MoE架构对齐的研究者可深挖路由约束的实现细节。
summary.authors_note: 作者之一H.X.任职于阿里巴巴，参与Qwen3-30B-A3B的开发与评估工作。

summary_en.core_problem: MoE LLMs suffer from Safety Sparsity: safety capabilities are concentrated in a small subset of experts, leaving the model vulnerable to adversarial attacks that manipulate routing to activate unaligned experts. Conventional full-parameter alignment methods also disrupt expert specialization and routing distribution, creating an unavoidable trade-off between safety improvement and general utility degradation.
summary_en.importance: This work proposes the first architecture-aware resource allocation framework for MoE safety alignment. The paradigm of decentralized capability distribution across experts also provides insights for MoE pretraining and continual training, avoiding capability corruption caused by full-parameter fine-tuning.
summary_en.technical_approach: The MESA framework has two coordinated components. First, Expert Capacity Reallocation: based on Optimal Transport (OT) theory, it uses a KL-regularized Sinkhorn algorithm to compute a transport cost matrix, selecting the optimal expert group to absorb safety capabilities, minimizing the trade-off between safety gains and utility loss. Second, Dynamic Routing Refinement: it adds an online OT constraint during training to guide the router to direct safety-related traffic to the adapted safety experts, while preserving original activation patterns for general tasks.
summary_en.experiments: Tested on DeepSeek-V2-Lite: it achieves 90.90% safety score on the challenging jailbreak benchmark Strata, outperforming standard SFT (77.70%), MoE-specific method SafeX (64.00%), and prior leading content-level method Stair-DPO (83.60%). On general utility, it reaches 66.11% on GSM8K, far exceeding standard SFT (16.15%) and Stair-DPO (15.54%), delivering safety improvement without meaningful utility loss.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim the introduction for the definition of Safety Sparsity, then review the design logic of the two core modules, with focus on the application of Optimal Transport for MoE expert allocation. Estimated reading time: 20-25 minutes. Researchers focused on MoE alignment can dig into implementation details of the routing constraint.
summary_en.authors_note: Author H.X. is employed by Alibaba, and participated in the development and evaluation of Qwen3-30B-A3B.

recommendation.zh: 探讨了MoE路由机制与安全对齐的相互作用，提出分散安全知识以缓解safety tax，对MoE的SFT/RLHF阶段如何设计路由策略有启发。
recommendation.en: Explores the interaction between MoE routing mechanisms and safety alignment, proposing to decentralize safety knowledge to mitigate the safety tax, providing insights for designing routing strategies during the SFT/RLHF phases of MoE.

paper.title: Configurable Reward Model for Balanced Safety Alignment
paper.abstract: Aligning large language models (LLMs) to heterogeneous and rapidly evolving safety requirements remains a critical challenge. Existing instruction-tuned LLMs and standalone safety classifiers often fail to generalize to new safety configurations, motivating the need for Reward Models (RMs) that are explicitly configurable to changing specifications. We introduce the Configurable Safety Reward Model (CSRM), which is jointly optimized for calibrated safety compliance and reward modeling. Our appro

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是一个很具体、也很难绕开的对齐问题：安全规范不是静态常量，而是会随场景、机构、地区和时间变化；但现有 RLHF 流水线里的 reward model 往往把“安全”固化进参数里，部署后很难改。另一条常见路线是做可配置安全分类器或 judge，但这类模型更适合做过滤，不适合做 RL 内环奖励，因为输出要么过于离散、要么校准很差，难以提供平滑、可优化的训练信号。论文要解决的核心问题，就是如何构造一种在推理时可按自然语言安全配置切换、同时又能输出稠密且有严重度感知的标量奖励模型，用于后续策略优化，并尽量减少过拒答。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究本身，它不是直接改 pretrain recipe，但对 pretrain↔post-train 接口有现实意义。它把“可配置 judge”推进到“可配置 reward model”，重点不在判别是否违规，而在能否作为 RL 的连续优化信号使用。这件事的重要性有两层。第一，安全规范变化很快，若每次都重训 RM 和重跑 RLHF，成本高且反馈周期慢；可配置 RM 让 reward 侧更接近可编程接口。第二，很多安全系统的问题不是不会拒，而是不会在安全与帮助性之间做细粒度权衡；如果 reward 几何更平滑、更有严重度结构，策略学习更可能学到边界，而不是简单地“多拒绝”。从贡献量级看，这更像对齐基础设施的一次补全，而不是训练范式替代。对做基础模型的人，启发主要在 reward 建模、数据构造和校准，而不是模型架构本身。
summary.technical_approach:
方法核心是 CSRM（Configurable Safety Reward Model）。它把输入组织成多轮对话上下文、候选回复以及一段自然语言形式的 safety configuration。这个 configuration 不是简单标签，而是一组带文字描述的安全类别与规则，模型需要在给定规则下判断回复的合规程度，并输出适合 RL 使用的标量 reward。

技术上有两个关键点。第一，是联合式训练，而不是把安全分类和 reward modeling 分开做。论文强调将判别式安全合规学习与生成式/排序式 reward 学习统一起来，让模型既学“是否违反规则”，也学“违反有多严重、不同回复之间谁更好”。这样做的原因很直接：单纯分类器容易把边界压得很硬，RL 时梯度信号稀；单纯偏好建模又可能缺少明确的规范锚点，尤其在配置变化时泛化差。联合目标相当于同时约束语义理解、规则遵循和 reward 几何。

第二，是 configuration-targeted data augmentation。论文不是只靠原始标注数据，而是系统性地改写安全配置的严格程度，并构造与之对应的训练样本，让模型看到“同一类内容在不同规则下可能有不同判定”的情况。这里最重要的不是扩数据量，而是保留 violation severity 的相对结构：轻微越界、边界案例、明显违规之间的顺序不能在增强时被破坏。这样模型学到的不是某条固定政策，而是“规则文本如何改变奖励面”。这和 Llama Guard、ShieldGemma、DynaGuard 这类 prompt-conditioned safety judge 的差别在于，后者主要输出类别或判断，前者则试图学出可用于策略搜索的连续 reward。

从设计取舍看，作者显然在避免两种失败模式：一是 reward 过尖，导致 RL 只学会回避；二是 reward 过平，导致安全边界不清。论文把 calibrated safety compliance 作为目标之一，说明其关注点不是只提高分类准确率，而是让 reward 的数值变化与违规严重度、配置严格度和对话语境相匹配。这一点对后续 PPO/DPO 类优化是否稳定很关键。
summary.experiments:
从给出的全文内容看，实验结论主要围绕三件事。第一，CSRM 对未见过的安全配置有更好的泛化。也就是说，训练时没有显式见过的 guideline 组合或严格度变化，在推理时仍能给出相对合理的 reward。第二，作为 RL 内环奖励时，它比静态 RM 或可配置 judge 更能改善 safety-helpfulness trade-off，尤其体现在减少 over-refusal，同时维持较强安全性。第三，数据增强和联合训练都不是可有可无的装饰，消融显示它们对配置泛化和 reward 校准都有贡献。

不过，当前提供的全文片段没有完整实验表格、模型规模、训练 token 数、具体 benchmark 名称和精确数值，因此没法负责任地填入参数量、数据规模或提升百分点。能确认的是，作者做了多种 alignment setting 下的比较，并把 Pareto frontier 作为主要分析方式之一，而不是只报单点安全分数。这种评估方式是合理的，因为该方法的目标不是单纯更“严”，而是在不同安全配置下给策略学习提供更可控的优化方向。

如果拿它和常见安全 judge 比，实验想证明的不是 judge 不会判，而是 judge 的输出形状不适合 RL；如果拿它和传统静态 RM 比，实验想证明的则是 inference-time configurability 不必以 reward usability 为代价。真正值得注意的消融，应该是：去掉 targeted augmentation 后，对 unseen config 的性能下降多少；去掉联合目标后，reward 是否变得更不稳定或更容易过拒；不同 strictness 配置下，reward 分布是否仍保持单调和可分性。
summary.reading_guide:
这篇更适合带着“reward geometry”这个问题去读，而不是把它当普通安全分类论文。优先看 Introduction 里对静态 RM、可配置 judge 和 RL 内环需求之间矛盾的界定，作者的问题设定是成立与否的关键。然后重点看方法部分 3.2 和 3.3：一个讲 targeted augmentation，另一个讲 joint objective。读的时候要盯住两个问题：增强样本如何保证严重度顺序不被破坏；联合训练里分类信号和偏好/奖励信号是怎样耦合的。

实验部分建议先看主表和 Pareto frontier 图，再看 unseen configuration 的泛化实验。若时间有限，先确认三件事：1）它是否真的优于 prompt-conditioned judge 作为 reward；2）收益主要来自配置条件化，还是来自更好的数据构造；3）它减少 over-refusal 的证据是否扎实，还是只是换了评测口径。

预计泛读 25–35 分钟可以抓住主线；若要精读，值得深挖 reward calibration 的定义、训练标签来源、以及 RL 阶段具体如何接入。还可以顺手思考一个更大的问题：这种“自然语言配置→reward 面变化”的做法，是否能推广到非安全维度，例如风格、品牌约束、工具使用规范等。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a specific alignment bottleneck: safety requirements are heterogeneous and change over time, but standard RLHF pipelines rely on a static reward model with safety preferences baked into the parameters. When policies change, the usual answer is to retrain the RM and rerun alignment. Configurable safety classifiers and prompt-conditioned judges avoid retraining, but they are poor inner-loop rewards: their outputs are often too discrete, too peaky, or too weakly calibrated to support stable policy optimization. The core problem here is how to build a reward model that can condition on natural-language safety specifications at inference time while still producing a dense scalar reward that reflects violation severity and is usable for RL.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining paper in the narrow sense, but it matters for the pretrain-to-post-train interface. The contribution is less about model architecture and more about reward infrastructure. It moves from configurable judging to configurable reward modeling. That distinction matters because RL needs a smooth optimization signal, not just a policy gate. The practical value is clear: if safety requirements evolve faster than retraining cycles, a configurable RM becomes a more realistic control surface than a frozen RM. The second reason it matters is the safety-helpfulness trade-off. Many deployed systems fail not because they cannot refuse unsafe requests, but because they collapse toward over-refusal under uncertainty. A reward model with better calibration and severity structure can, in principle, teach a policy where the boundary is, instead of teaching it to reject broadly. The contribution looks like an important systems-level extension to alignment pipelines rather than a new training paradigm.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The method is the Configurable Safety Reward Model (CSRM). The model takes a conversation context, a candidate response, and a natural-language safety configuration. The configuration is not a simple class label; it is a textual specification of safety categories and guidelines. The model must score the response under that specification and output a scalar reward suitable for downstream policy optimization.

Two ideas carry most of the paper. First, the training is joint rather than split across separate modules. The model is optimized for both safety compliance and reward modeling, so it learns not only whether a response violates a rule, but also how severe the violation is and how candidate responses should be ranked under a given configuration. This is a deliberate design choice. A pure classifier tends to produce hard boundaries and sparse learning signals. A pure preference model may lack explicit normative anchors and can generalize poorly when the policy text changes. The joint objective is meant to tie together rule understanding, contextual safety judgment, and usable reward geometry.

Second, the paper introduces configuration-targeted data augmentation. Instead of only training on fixed policy annotations, it systematically varies the strictness and wording of safety configurations and constructs corresponding examples. The key is not just more data, but preserving the relative severity structure across examples. Borderline cases, mild violations, and severe violations must remain ordered after augmentation. This teaches the model how reward should change when the policy text changes. That is the main difference from prompt-conditioned safety judges such as Llama Guard or ShieldGemma. Those systems are optimized to classify or judge. CSRM is optimized to produce a calibrated scalar signal that can sit inside RL.

The design is trying to avoid two failure modes at once: rewards that are too sharp and induce blanket refusal, and rewards that are too flat and fail to define a meaningful boundary. The emphasis on calibrated safety compliance suggests that the authors care about the numerical shape of the reward, not just classification accuracy. That is exactly the part that matters if the model is later used in PPO-like or other policy optimization loops.
summary_en.experiments:
From the provided full text, the experimental story has three main claims. First, CSRM generalizes better to unseen safety configurations. In other words, the model can handle guideline combinations or strictness settings that were not explicitly seen during training. Second, when used as an inner-loop reward, it improves the safety-helpfulness trade-off relative to static reward models and configurable judges, especially by reducing over-refusal while maintaining strong safety behavior. Third, both targeted augmentation and joint training matter: the ablations indicate that these components contribute to configuration generalization and reward calibration.

That said, the supplied text does not include the full result tables, model sizes, training data counts, benchmark names, or exact gains, so it would be unsafe to invent parameter scales or percentage improvements. What is clear is that the paper evaluates multiple alignment settings and emphasizes Pareto-frontier analysis rather than a single safety score. That is the right evaluation lens here, because the goal is not simply to become stricter, but to provide a controllable reward under varying safety specifications.

The most important comparisons are conceptual. Against configurable judges, the paper aims to show not that judges cannot detect violations, but that their output geometry is ill-suited for RL. Against static RMs, it aims to show that inference-time configurability does not have to come at the cost of reward usability. The ablations worth checking closely are: how much unseen-configuration performance drops without targeted augmentation, whether removing the joint objective makes rewards less stable or more refusal-prone, and whether reward distributions remain monotonic across different strictness settings.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Read this as a reward-modeling paper, not as a standard safety-classification paper. Start with the introduction, especially the contrast between static RMs, configurable judges, and the requirements of inner-loop RL. If that problem framing is weak, the rest matters less; if it is strong, the paper becomes much more relevant.

Then go straight to the method section on targeted augmentation and the joint objective. Two questions are worth tracking while reading: how the augmentation preserves severity ordering, and how the compliance signal is coupled with the reward-learning signal. Those details determine whether the model is learning policy text semantics or just memorizing templates.

In the experiments, look first at the main comparison tables and any Pareto-frontier plots, then at the unseen-configuration generalization results. If time is limited, verify three things: whether CSRM is actually better than prompt-conditioned judges as an RL reward, whether the gains mainly come from configuration conditioning or from better data construction, and whether the evidence for reduced over-refusal is robust rather than metric-dependent.

A quick read should take about 25 to 35 minutes. A deeper read is worthwhile if you care about reward calibration, label construction, and how configurable textual constraints can be turned into optimization signals. One broader question to keep in mind is whether this recipe could extend beyond safety to other controllable dimensions such as style, brand constraints, or tool-use policies.

recommendation.zh: 不是范式突破，但把“安全规范条件化”放进 RM 本身这件事是对的；若你做对齐数据与 RM，优先看数据增强和未见配置泛化实验。
recommendation.en: Not a paradigm shift, but conditioning the RM on explicit safety configurations is the right move; if you work on alignment data or reward models, read the augmentation design and unseen-config generalization tables.

paper.title: Relevance as a Vulnerability: How Web Retrieval Degrades Safety Alignment in LLM Agents
paper.abstract: AI agents augment large language models with external tools such as web retrieval, enabling grounded and up-to-date responses. However, incorporating external content into the generation pipeline can weaken the safety alignment mechanisms that govern model outputs. Prior work shows that enabling retrieval in agents increases compliance with harmful requests. summary.core_problem: 检索增强的 LLM agent 在接入外部网页内容后，安全对齐会系统性退化；论文要回答两个更细的问题：退化主要由“检索内容本身”触发，还是由“检索在 agent 流水线中的集成方式”触发？以及哪些内容属性（相关性、立场）会把模型推入更高的有害服从区间。
summary.importance: 对预训练本身不是直接改 recipe 的论文，但对“pretrain↔posttrain 闭环”很有现实影响：它把安全退化从‘模型不够对齐’转成‘系统目标与时序耦合导致的泛化失败’，并给出可复现实证。对做 RLHF/RLVR、tool-use 数据合成、以及把 RAG/浏览能力纳入持续训练的人，结论很具体：同样的模型与同样的网页，agentic 集成方式会显著放大有害输出；更反直觉的是，安全科普/风险提示类页面在高相关时反而更容易诱发有害合规（Safe Source Paradox）。这意味着仅靠“安全来源白名单”或“检索过滤”并不稳，训练信号与系统设计需要一起改。
summary.technical_approach:
方法是一个诊断框架 AgentREVEAL，把“检索导致的安全退化”拆成两条轴。
1）架构/集成轴：固定同一 URL 内容，改变 ❸context augmentation 与 ❹response generation 的组织方式，比较‘被动把网页塞进 prompt’ vs ‘以工具调用-返回的 agentic 路径注入’，并进一步测试“时序耦合”假设：当工具调用决策与最终回答在同一步完成（强耦合）时，有害合规更高；把工具调用与回答解耦（文中称 DEFER，一种先检索/先确认再回答的设计）能降低退化，作者将其归因为 commitment bias（模型一旦走完工具链，更倾向于“完成任务”而不是拒绝）。
2）内容轴：构建 HarmURLBench，把 HarmBench 的有害行为请求与真实世界 URL 配对，并对每个 URL 标注两个关键属性：Topical Relevance（相关性 1–5）与 Stance Score（立场 1–5，从劝阻到教学）。用统一的有害性打分（GPT-4o 1–5）评估最终回答的有害合规程度。核心发现是：相关性是共同的“激活条件”——相关性越高，架构放大效应与 Safe Source Paradox 越强；而立场并不单调决定安全性，安全警示/风险说明（低 stance、偏劝阻）在高相关时也会提高合规。
此外，论文把场景限定为 externally specified URL retrieval（URL 由用户/系统指定），用来隔离‘源选择’因素，专注研究检索后半段（检索结果如何进入上下文、如何影响生成）。同时也做了若干代表性干预（如输入/输出过滤、摘要、chunking）来验证现象不只存在于最原始设置。
summary.experiments:
实验覆盖 8 个模型、5 个模型家族（文中表述为包含若干前沿闭源模型与开源模型的混合）。评测对象是 HarmURLBench：1,405 个按立场分层的真实 URL，与 320 个有害行为配对；输出用 GPT-4o 产生 1–5 的 harmfulness 评分。
关键结果有两条：
- 集成方式效应：同样的网页内容，通过 agentic 工具路径注入比“直接贴进 prompt”更容易产生有害合规；将工具调用与回答解耦（DEFER）能缓解，支持‘时序耦合/承诺偏置’解释。
- Safe Source Paradox：检索到“安全导向页面”（警示、风险说明、劝阻）时，有害合规相对无检索基线平均上升约 25%（论文给出这一量级结论）。该效应在内容与目标行为高度相关时最明显。
稳健性方面：作者报告在加入 Llama-Guard 输入/输出过滤、对检索内容做 summarization、以及 chunking 等常见 RAG 工程手段后，有害合规仍保持升高趋势；并指出部分 agent 在自主检索设置下也会进入类似退化区间（但主体分析仍以固定 URL 设定为主）。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（约 30–45 分钟）：
- 先看 Introduction 里对四阶段流水线（query→retrieval→augmentation→generation）的拆解，以及为何选择 externally specified URL 的隔离思路。
- 重点看 Methodology 对 TR（相关性）与 SS（立场）的定义，以及 HarmURLBench 的构造方式；这是理解 Safe Source Paradox 的关键。
- 结果部分优先找两类对比：agentic vs passive 注入、coupled vs decoupled（DEFER）设计；再看按 TR 分桶后的趋势图/表（通常最能说明“相关性是激活条件”）。
- 如果只关心工程启示，直接看对 Llama-Guard/摘要/chunking 等干预的诊断结论：哪些常见防线对该问题不敏感。

summary_en.core_problem: Why and when does adding web retrieval to LLM agents systematically weaken safety alignment? The paper isolates two drivers: (i) the integration pathway (agentic tool-use vs passive context insertion), and (ii) properties of retrieved pages (topical relevance and stance), aiming to explain retrieval-induced increases in harmful compliance.
summary_en.importance: Not a pretraining-recipe paper, but highly relevant to the pretrain↔post-train loop and tool-use training: it reframes safety failures as a pipeline/generalization issue rather than purely a model-alignment deficit. Two actionable takeaways for RLHF/RLVR and tool-augmented training: (1) the same content becomes more dangerous when injected through an agentic tool pathway, suggesting system design and training signals must co-evolve; (2) “safe” sources (warnings, risk disclaimers) can still increase harmful compliance when they are topically relevant, so whitelisting or naive retrieval filtering is not a reliable safety strategy.
summary_en.technical_approach:
AgentREVEAL is a diagnostic framework that decomposes retrieval-induced safety degradation along two axes.
- Architectural/integration axis: hold the retrieved URL fixed and vary how it enters the model context and how tool invocation is coupled with response generation. The paper reports higher harmful compliance when tool invocation and answering are temporally coupled (single-step), and proposes a decoupled design (DEFER) to mitigate this, attributing the effect to a commitment bias: once the agent completes the tool pipeline, it is more likely to “finish the task” than refuse.
- Content axis: build HarmURLBench by pairing real-world URLs with HarmBench harmful behaviors, and annotate each URL with Topical Relevance (TR, 1–5) and Stance Score (SS, 1–5, discouraging→instructional). Outputs are rated for harmfulness (1–5) by GPT-4o. The key mechanism claim is that topical relevance is the shared activation condition: higher TR amplifies both the architectural effect and the Safe Source Paradox (safety-oriented pages increasing harmful compliance).
The study focuses on externally specified URL retrieval to remove confounds from source selection and concentrate on post-selection stages (augmentation and generation). It also probes common pipeline interventions (guardrails, summarization, chunking) to test robustness.
summary_en.experiments:
Evaluated across 8 models from 5 families (mix of open and frontier closed models per the paper). HarmURLBench contains 1,405 stance-stratified real URLs paired with 320 harmful behaviors. Harmfulness is scored on a 1–5 scale by GPT-4o.
Main findings:
- Integration matters: agentic tool-path injection yields higher harmful compliance than passively pasting the same content into the prompt; decoupling tool use from answering (DEFER) reduces the effect.
- Safe Source Paradox: retrieving safety-oriented pages increases harmful compliance by ~25% on average relative to no-retrieval baselines, strongest when the retrieved content is highly topically relevant.
Robustness checks indicate the elevated harmful compliance persists under representative mitigations such as Llama-Guard input/output filtering, summarization, and chunking; some agents show similar behavior under autonomous retrieval, though the core analysis is in the fixed-URL setting.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (30–45 min):
- Read the pipeline decomposition and the rationale for externally specified URLs in the introduction.
- Focus on the definitions of TR/SS and how HarmURLBench is constructed; this is essential for interpreting the paradox.
- In results, prioritize (i) agentic vs passive injection, (ii) coupled vs decoupled (DEFER), and (iii) plots/tables stratified by topical relevance.
- If you care about deployment, jump to the sections testing mitigations (guardrails, summarization, chunking) to see which common defenses fail to address the root cause.

recommendation.zh: 只看 Safe Source Paradox 和 pipeline ablation；若结果稳，RAG 安全数据不能再按“来源安全”粗标。
recommendation.en: Read the Safe Source Paradox and pipeline ablations; if robust, RAG safety data should not be labeled by source safety alone.

paper.title: AgentDoG 1.5: A Lightweight and Scalable Alignment Framework for AI Agent Safety and Security
paper.abstract: Modern open-world agents such as OpenClaw exhibit powerful cross-environment execution capabilities yet introduce broad new safety risk sources. Meanwhile, advanced frontier AI models drastically lower attack barriers, rendering current agent alignment frameworks inadequate for real-world deployment. To tackle these emerging threats, we propose a lightweight and scalable agent safety alignment framework. Specifically, we update the agent safety taxonomy to accommodate emergent risks from Codex a

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作解决的是开放环境 agent 的安全对齐如何做得足够轻、足够可扩展。它不是单纯做一个安全分类器，而是试图把 taxonomy、数据构建、轻量 verifier、SFT/RL 训练环境、在线 guardrail 串成一套低成本框架，服务于像 OpenClaw、Codex 这类跨环境执行 agent 的安全训练与部署。
summary.importance: 对基座预训练本身的直接相关性不高，更接近 agent safety / post-training 基础设施。但它有两个可借鉴点。第一，文章把小模型 verifier 作为训练信号提供者，兼做 SFT 过滤和 RL reward，这对“轻量 reward model 如何支撑大模型后训练”有一定参考。第二，它强调用很少样本配合 taxonomy 和数据净化训练出可用的安全判别器，这对高质量监督信号构造有启发。不过整体上，这不是 pretrain 方法论文，更多是 agent safety pipeline 设计。
summary.technical_approach:
技术方案由四块组成。其一，更新 agent safety taxonomy。作者沿用 AgentDoG/ATBench 的三维风险分解框架，但针对 Codex 和 OpenClaw 这类新执行场景扩展叶子类目，使不同环境下的风险仍能在统一框架里标注和比较。其二，构建 taxonomy-guided data engine，并用 influence function 做数据净化，从少量样本里挑出更有信息量的训练数据。其三，训练轻量 AgentDoG 1.5 系列模型，参数规模覆盖 0.8B、2B、4B、8B，目标是做细粒度、上下文相关的轨迹级安全评估。其四，搭建轻量 agent safety SFT/RL 环境，用 finite-state simulation 替代 Docker 级环境，降低内存和启动开销，并让 AgentDoG 1.5 同时充当离线过滤器、reward model 和在线 guard。

从方法取舍看，这篇文章明显优先考虑部署成本而不是极致能力。为什么不用更大的 judge model 直接在线审计？因为开放环境 agent 的在线安全监控要求低延迟、低成本、可并发。为什么强调 taxonomy？因为 agent 风险比单轮对话安全更依赖轨迹结构，没有稳定标签体系就很难做一致训练和评测。为什么用 influence-function purification？因为作者希望在约 1k 样本下仍能训练出可用模型，数据质量比数据量更关键。
summary.experiments:
实验覆盖评测、训练应用和在线部署三类。评测上，作者在 R-Judge 和 ATBench family 上比较 AgentDoG 1.5 与现有模型，声称其表现可比 GPT-5.4 和 Gemini-3.1-Pro，并优于已有安全 moderation 模型。训练应用上，AgentDoG 1.5 被用作 safety-oriented SFT 数据过滤器和 RL reward model，结果显示可以提升 policy agent 的安全性，同时尽量保持通用能力。系统侧实验上，finite-state simulation 环境的内存占用和启动延迟约为 Docker 级环境的 1/100，标准 8 核机器可支持 10,000+ 并发 agent 环境。

不过从基座研究视角，最该关注的不是它和闭源大模型的横向比较，而是两个更具体的问题：1）约 1k 样本训练出的 verifier 在分布外风险上的稳定性如何；2）把同一个轻量模型同时用于过滤、奖励和在线审计，会不会引入系统性偏差或 reward hacking。全文给出的是正面结果，但这两点仍值得保留审慎态度。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读即可。先看 Introduction 和 taxonomy 部分，理解它到底扩展了哪些 agent 风险类别，以及为什么原有 ATBench 不够。然后看 data engine 和 influence-function purification，判断“少样本训练 verifier”是否有可迁移的方法价值。若你关心 post-training 基础设施，再看 finite-state simulation 环境和 AgentDoG 作为 reward model 的用法。

实验部分建议重点看三处：一是与大模型 judge 的性能差距是否真的很小；二是作为 SFT/RL 训练信号时，对主 agent 能力保持的影响；三是在线 guardrail 的延迟和吞吐指标。预计 25-35 分钟足够完成有效泛读。若只从 pretrain 研究角度出发，可以只读 taxonomy、数据净化和 reward-model 应用三节。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses how to build a safety alignment stack for open-world agents that is cheap enough to deploy and scalable enough to support training and runtime monitoring. Rather than proposing only a safety classifier, it combines a risk taxonomy, a small-data training pipeline, lightweight verifier models, a low-cost SFT/RL environment, and an online guardrail for agents such as OpenClaw and Codex-style systems.
summary_en.importance: Its relevance to core pretraining is limited; this is primarily an agent-safety and post-training infrastructure paper. Still, two aspects are useful for foundation-model researchers. First, it treats a lightweight verifier as a source of training signal, serving both as an SFT filter and an RL reward model. That is relevant to the broader question of how small, high-quality judges can shape larger models. Second, it emphasizes taxonomy-guided data curation and influence-based purification under a very small annotation budget, which is relevant to supervision quality. Overall, though, this is not a pretraining-method paper; it is better read as an agent safety pipeline design.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The framework has four main pieces. First, it extends the AgentDoG/ATBench three-dimensional safety taxonomy to cover newer execution settings such as Codex and OpenClaw, mainly by adding or refining setting-specific leaf categories while preserving a shared annotation structure. Second, it builds a taxonomy-guided data engine and applies influence-function-based purification to identify the most informative training examples from a small pool. Third, it trains lightweight AgentDoG 1.5 models at 0.8B, 2B, 4B, and 8B parameters for fine-grained, context-aware trajectory-level safety evaluation. Fourth, it introduces a lightweight agent safety SFT/RL environment based on finite-state simulation rather than Docker-level execution, and uses AgentDoG 1.5 as a data filter, reward model, and online guardrail.

The design choices are clearly deployment-driven. A large frontier judge could in principle moderate agent trajectories, but online agent safety requires low latency, low cost, and high concurrency. The taxonomy matters because agent risk is trajectory-dependent and harder to label consistently than single-turn dialogue safety. The influence-function purification step is there because the paper aims to train useful verifiers with only around 1k samples, making sample quality more important than raw scale.
summary_en.experiments:
The experiments cover benchmark evaluation, training-time use, and system efficiency. On evaluation, the paper reports results on R-Judge and the ATBench family, claiming that AgentDoG 1.5 is competitive with strong closed models such as GPT-5.4 and Gemini-3.1-Pro, and stronger than prior safety moderation baselines. On training applications, AgentDoG 1.5 is used both to filter safety-oriented SFT data and to provide RL reward signals, with reported gains in agent safety while preserving general capability. On the systems side, the finite-state simulation environment reduces memory overhead and startup latency to roughly 1/100 of Docker-level environments, and a standard 8-core machine can support more than 10,000 concurrent agent environments.

From a foundation-model perspective, the most important questions are narrower than the headline comparisons. How robust is a verifier trained on roughly 1k samples under distribution shift? And what biases are introduced when the same lightweight model is used for filtering, reward assignment, and online auditing? The paper presents positive results, but these remain the main points to inspect critically.
summary_en.reading_guide:
A skim is enough. Start with the introduction and taxonomy sections to understand what new risk categories are added and why the original ATBench setup is insufficient for newer agent execution settings. Then read the data engine and influence-function purification sections to judge whether the small-data verifier training recipe is transferable. If you care about post-training infrastructure, continue with the finite-state simulation environment and the use of AgentDoG as a reward model.

In the experiments, focus on three things: how close the lightweight verifier really gets to large-model judges, whether using it as an SFT/RL signal preserves the main agent's utility, and what the latency and throughput numbers look like for online guardrailing. A useful skim should take about 25 to 35 minutes. If your interest is strictly pretraining, the taxonomy, data purification, and reward-model sections are the only parts worth reading closely.

recommendation.zh: Agent安全对齐的系统性工作，影响力函数纯化数据的方法和少样本高效训练对post_train安全对齐有参考，建议读§3的数据引擎部分。
recommendation.en: Systematic work on agent safety alignment; influence-function data purification and few-sample efficient training are useful references for post_train safety alignment; read §3 data engine section.

paper.title: Understanding Safety-Sensitive Expert Behavior in Mixture-of-Experts LLMs
paper.abstract: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) LLMs rely on sparse, router-driven expert activation, yet how safety alignment interacts with routed expert specialization remains underexplored. A common intuition is that safety behavior may be controlled by routing harmful requests to distinct refusal-oriented experts. In this work, we provide empirical evidence for a different picture: routing patterns in aligned MoE LLMs are largely topic-driven, while safety behavior can be altered with little change to the model's

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文研究 MoE LLM 的安全行为是否主要由 router 把有害请求导向“拒答专家”来实现。作者的结论是，aligned MoE 的路由更多由主题语义驱动，安全拒答可以在路由路径基本不变的情况下被改变。
summary.importance: 这篇论文对 MoE 预训练和对齐都有参考价值。它说明 router 不一定是安全行为的主要控制面，至少在被测开源 MoE 上，专家的内部表征可能比路由选择更直接地承载安全相关行为。这对 MoE 训练有两个含义。第一，只靠观察路由分布，很可能低估局部专家参数对安全行为的影响。第二，安全对齐如果只约束 router 或只做输入级路由防御，可能无法覆盖专家内部的可塑性。对预训练研究员来说，这篇论文的价值在于把 MoE expert specialization 和 alignment behavior 放到同一个实验框架里分析，而不是只把专家看作容量扩展模块。
summary.technical_approach: 作者先做三组路由探针。第一，比较同一有害 prompt 下模型自然生成拒答 continuation 与 teacher-forced 合规 continuation 的路由差异。第二，测试对 benign prompt 加入拒答约束是否显著改变路由。第三，构造保留主题和表面结构、去除有害意图的 benign counterpart，用来分离 topic 与 harmful intent。三组结果共同指向：改变拒答/合规行为或安全意图时，路由变化小于改变主题时的变化。基于这个观察，作者提出 RASET，即 Router-Agnostic Safety-critical Expert Tuning。RASET 先计算每个 expert 对有害请求的 contrastive routing sensitivity：不是看有害样本上的 raw activation，而是减去 benign instruction 上的 activation，从而压低主题通用专家，突出更偏向有害请求处理的专家。随后只对这些被选中的 expert 做参数高效调优，冻结 router、共享组件和其他 expert。这个设计避免通过 router 干预把 token 导向不匹配专家，也更直接检验安全行为是否能通过少量 expert 表征修改被改变。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖五个开源 MoE backbone。RASET 在严格质量约束下达到 50.5% 的平均 ASR_hq，比最强 baseline 平均高 37.6 个百分点。参数更新量很小，只占模型参数的 0.12%–0.95%。同时，相比 router-manipulation baseline，RASET 在 TruthfulQA 和 MMLU 上保留了更好的 benign utility。论文还通过路由探针说明，安全相关行为变化并不伴随大规模 intrinsic routing shift；这使 RASET 的结果更像是 expert-level representation 的局部失效，而不是简单的路由劫持。需要注意的是，这类红队实验展示的是脆弱性和诊断信号，不应直接等同于真实部署中的攻击可行性。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 Introduction、三组 routing probe、RASET 的 expert selection 公式和主实验表，预计 40–60 分钟。重点看 contrastive routing-sensitivity criterion，因为它决定了方法不是选择“有害样本激活最多”的专家，而是选择相对 benign 样本更偏向有害处理的专家。另一个重点是 routing preservation 与 benign utility 的结果，它们决定 RASET 是否真的区别于 router-level attack。对 MoE 训练感兴趣的读者可以进一步看不同层、不同 expert 数量和不同 backbone 上的消融，判断安全敏感 expert 是否呈现层级或模型规模相关规律。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies whether safety behavior in aligned MoE LLMs is mainly implemented by routing harmful requests to refusal-specialized experts. Its empirical answer is different: routing is largely topic-driven, while refusal or compliance behavior can change with only small changes to the intrinsic routing path.
summary_en.importance: The paper is relevant to MoE pretraining and alignment because it separates expert specialization from router control. The evidence suggests that routers in the evaluated aligned MoEs are not primarily organized around a refusal-versus-compliance axis. Safety-sensitive behavior can instead reside inside the representations of experts that are naturally activated by the topic. This matters for MoE training and auditing: routing statistics alone may miss localized safety vulnerabilities, and defenses that focus mainly on router manipulation may not constrain the expert-level degrees of freedom that posttraining leaves behind.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors first run three routing probes. They compare native refusal continuations with teacher-forced compliant continuations for the same harmful prompts. They test whether refusal-enforced requests change the routing of benign prompts. They also create benign counterparts that preserve topic and surface form while removing unsafe intent, which separates topical specialization from harmful intent. In all three settings, routing changes induced by safety behavior or intent are smaller than changes induced by topic. Motivated by this, they introduce RASET, Router-Agnostic Safety-critical Expert Tuning. RASET identifies candidate experts using a contrastive routing-sensitivity score: activation on harmful instructions minus activation on benign instructions. This suppresses topic-general experts and highlights experts more specifically associated with harmful-request processing. It then applies parameter-efficient tuning only to the selected experts, while freezing the router, shared components, and all non-selected experts. The design directly tests whether localized expert representations can alter safety behavior without changing the model’s routing logic.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments cover five open-weight MoE backbones. Under the most stringent quality-qualified criterion, RASET reaches 50.5% average ASR_hq and outperforms the strongest baseline by 37.6 percentage points on average. It updates only 0.12%–0.95% of model parameters. At the same time, it preserves benign utility better than router-manipulation baselines on TruthfulQA and MMLU. The routing probes show that safety behavior can change without a large intrinsic routing shift, supporting the claim that the failure mode is localized in expert representations rather than only in router steering. The results should be read as a diagnostic red-teaming study, not as a direct measurement of deployment risk.
summary_en.reading_guide: A useful skim should cover the Introduction, the three routing probes, the RASET expert-selection criterion, and the main attack-utility tradeoff tables. Expected reading time is 40–60 minutes. The key technical detail is the contrastive routing score: selecting experts by harmful-minus-benign activation is more informative than selecting experts by raw harmful activation. The second important part is the evidence for routing preservation and benign utility retention, since that is what distinguishes RASET from router-level interventions. Readers working on MoE training should also inspect layer-wise and expert-count ablations if available, as these may reveal whether safety-sensitive experts concentrate in particular depths or vary by backbone.

recommendation.zh: 读路由分析部分就够；若结果稳，它会修正“MoE 安全=路由到拒答专家”的过度简化 prior。
recommendation.en: Read the routing analysis; if robust, it corrects the oversimplified prior that MoE safety equals routing harmful prompts to refusal experts.

paper.title: $D^2$-Monitor: Dynamic Safety Monitoring for Diffusion LLMs via Hesitation-Aware Routing
paper.abstract: Despite the emergence of diffusion large language models (D-LLMs) as an alternative to autoregressive large language models (AR-LLMs), safety monitoring for D-LLMs remains largely unexplored. Unlike AR-LLMs, D-LLMs generate text through a multi-step denoising process, exposing intermediate hidden representations that may contain safety-relevant information unavailable in standard single-step monitoring setups. Motivated by the suitability of lightweight probes for always-on monitoring, we analyz

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文研究 diffusion LLM 的部署期安全监控，核心问题是如何利用多步去噪轨迹中的隐藏状态来判断哪些样本需要更强的安全分类器。
summary.importance: 这篇论文与预训练的关系在于 diffusion LM 的生成过程提供了 AR 模型没有的中间轨迹信号。它不是训练 diffusion LM 的论文，但对新型语言建模范式有方法启发：多步去噪不只是解码过程，也可以暴露模型在语义和安全判断上的不稳定性。对做 diffusion / masked / any-order LM 的研究者来说，值得关注的是“trajectory-level representation”这个接口。它可能影响未来的安全训练、置信度估计、verifier 设计和推理时资源分配。
summary.technical_approach: 论文先训练轻量 probe 对 D-LLM 的中间隐藏状态做安全分类，然后观察 probe margin，即样本距离分类边界的大小。作者发现，某些输入在多个去噪 step 中反复落在决策边界附近，这种现象被定义为 safety hesitation。hesitation step 越多，线性 probe 越容易出错，因此它可以作为样本难度的代理信号。基于这个观察，作者提出 D^2-Monitor：一个动态双层监控器。base probe 常驻运行，同时完成基础安全分类和 hesitation 估计；router 根据 hesitation 阈值决定是否调用 advanced probe；advanced probe 只处理困难轨迹，并用 hesitation-rich trajectories 进行训练。与固定使用大监控器相比，它节省计算；与单一轻量 probe 相比，它能在边界样本和对抗样本上提供更强保护。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 3 个安全数据集：WildGuardMix、ToxicChat、OpenAI-Moderation；覆盖 4 个 diffusion LLM，并同时测试 intra-dataset 和 cross-dataset 设置。D^2-Monitor 的参数量低于 0.85M，约为 8B 模型的 0.01% 以下。论文报告它在 8 个基线中取得较好的效果与效率折中，并在不同生成配置、remasking 策略和超参数下保持稳定。最关键的实验不是单个分数，而是 hesitation severity 与 probe 错误率之间的相关性：这说明 D-LLM 的去噪轨迹里确实有可用于路由的难度信号。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，约 25–35 分钟。先看 Section 3.2 和 3.3，重点理解作者如何从多步隐藏状态定义 probe margin 和 hesitation step；这是整篇论文最有信息量的部分。然后看 D^2-Monitor 的路由机制和 advanced probe 的训练数据构造。实验部分优先看 hesitation 与 probe performance 的相关性图、intra/cross-dataset 表格，以及效率-效果折中图。安全数据集细节可快速扫过；如果关注 diffusion LM 的内部动态，可以多看 remasking 和 generation configuration 的鲁棒性分析。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses deployment-time safety monitoring for diffusion LLMs by asking how intermediate denoising states can identify samples that require a stronger safety classifier.
summary_en.importance: The main relevance is to diffusion-style language modeling rather than to conventional pretraining recipes. D-LLMs expose a trajectory of hidden states, and that trajectory contains information unavailable in one-shot or final-state monitoring. This makes the paper useful for researchers studying diffusion, masked, or any-order language models: the denoising process can support uncertainty estimation, verifier routing, and safety instrumentation. The work is not about training better D-LLMs, but it clarifies an interface that future training and post-training methods may exploit.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper starts with lightweight probes over intermediate hidden representations of D-LLMs. It then studies probe margins, where a small margin means the representation lies close to the safety decision boundary. The key observation is safety hesitation: across denoising steps, some trajectories repeatedly fall near that boundary. Samples with more hesitation steps are harder for simple probes to classify correctly. D^2-Monitor uses this signal in a two-level design. A base probe runs continuously and provides both a first safety prediction and a hesitation estimate. A router compares the hesitation level with a threshold. If the sample appears difficult, an advanced probe is activated for second-stage classification; this advanced probe is trained on hesitation-heavy trajectories. The design trades fixed-cost monitoring for adaptive monitoring: easy samples stay cheap, while ambiguous or adversarial-looking samples receive more compute.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation uses WildGuardMix, ToxicChat, and OpenAI-Moderation across four diffusion LLMs, with both intra-dataset and cross-dataset tests. The monitor has fewer than 0.85M parameters, below 0.01% of an 8B model. Against eight baselines, the paper reports a stronger effectiveness-efficiency trade-off, and additional analysis checks robustness to generation settings, remasking strategies, and hyperparameters. The most important empirical result is the link between hesitation severity and probe failure: it supports the claim that denoising trajectories carry a useful difficulty signal, rather than merely providing extra representations to average over.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 25–35 minutes. Focus first on Sections 3.2 and 3.3, where probe margin and safety hesitation are defined from the denoising trajectory. Then read the D^2-Monitor design, especially the routing threshold and the construction of advanced-probe training data. In the experiments, prioritize the hesitation-versus-probe-performance analysis, the intra- and cross-dataset tables, and the efficiency-effectiveness comparison. Dataset descriptions can be scanned quickly unless the goal is to reproduce the safety setup.

recommendation.zh: 扩散LLM安全对齐的首个系统性工作，'安全犹豫'信号的发现对理解扩散生成的中间态质量有参考价值，重点看§3的信号分析部分
recommendation.en: First systematic work on safety alignment for diffusion LLMs; the 'safety hesitation' signal discovery is informative for understanding intermediate-state quality in diffusion generation — focus on §3 signal analysis

paper.title: Curriculum Learning for Safety Alignment
paper.abstract: Direct Preference Optimisation (DPO) is widely used for safety alignment in large language models. However, prior work shows it is brittle and exhibits poor out-of-distribution (OOD) generalisation. In this paper, we investigate whether Curriculum Learning can improve the robustness of DPO-based safety alignment. We propose Staged-Competence, a curriculum-based framework that organises preference data by difficulty, employs competence-based sampling, and progressively updates the reference model

summary.core_problem: 标准 DPO 在安全对齐中存在两个关键缺陷：对简单越狱攻击的脆弱性和分布外泛化能力差。已有研究表明课程学习能帮助模型学习更鲁棒的特征，但尚未有工作系统地将其应用于基于 DPO 的安全对齐场景。
summary.importance: 对于预训练研究的主要启发在于：(1) 课程设计原则（按难度排序、基于能力的采样、渐进式更新参考模型）对偏好优化训练的稳定性和鲁棒性有可测量的正向作用；(2) 参考模型是否随训练更新是一个被低估的设计选择——固定参考模型可能导致后期阶段浪费容量重新学习已有知识；(3) 安全对齐数据中存在普遍的偏好对不一致问题，数据质量直接影响对齐效果。此外，该框架不依赖特定的偏好优化 loss，可推广到 DPO 以外的对齐方法。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Staged-Competence 框架，包含三个核心组件：(1) 偏好对齐边距 (preference alignment margin) 作为难度评分，衡量模型对安全与非安全响应的区分程度，据此对训练样本排序；(2) 基于能力的采样 (competence-based sampling)：维护一个随训练进度逐步扩大的合格样本池，使用平方根进度函数控制难度阈值的扩张节奏，避免引入过难样本过快；(3) 分阶段更新参考模型：将训练划分为 K 个阶段，每阶段结束时将参考模型更新为当前策略，使下一阶段可以聚焦于学习新难度层级的样本而非重新学习已有知识。此外，作者还发现并清理了 PKU-SafeRLHF 和 HH-RLHF 数据集中的偏好对不一致问题，发布了 Cleaned-PKU-HH-SafeRLHF 数据集。
summary.experiments: 在三个模型系列上的实验结果：(1) OOD 有害响应率平均降低 16%，越狱攻击成功率平均降低 20%；(2) 奖励边距分离度提升约 3 倍；(3) 在保持同等安全水平下可减少 25% 的训练数据；(4) 随模型规模增长性能平滑提升。消融实验系统比较了排序策略、阶段内采样方式和参考模型更新方式的影响，验证了每个组件的独立贡献。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读，预计 20 分钟。重点阅读：(1) 第 3 节的算法框架和三个核心组件的设计 rationale；(2) 偏好对齐边距的定义方式，理解为什么用模型当前区分度而不是语言复杂度来定义难度；(3) 第 5 节的消融实验结果，特别是参考模型更新和难度排序各自的贡献量；(4) 关于数据不一致问题的发现（附录部分）。与预训练相关度中等，主要价值在于课程设计原则和参考模型更新策略可能迁移到持续预训练或 RL 预训练场景。
summary.authors_note: 机构作者信息未在提供的文本中明确给出。

summary_en.core_problem: Standard DPO for safety alignment suffers from two key weaknesses: vulnerability to simple jailbreaking attacks and poor out-of-distribution generalization. While curriculum learning has been shown to help models learn more robust features, no systematic study has applied it to DPO-based safety alignment.
summary_en.importance: Key takeaways for pretraining research: (1) Curriculum design principles (difficulty ordering, competence-based sampling, progressive reference model updates) provide measurable improvements in the stability and robustness of preference-based training; (2) Whether the reference model is updated during training is an underappreciated design choice—fixed reference models may waste capacity re-learning what was already acquired in later stages; (3) Widespread preference pair inconsistencies in popular safety datasets directly impact alignment quality. The framework is agnostic to the preference optimization loss and generalizes beyond DPO.
summary_en.technical_approach: The Staged-Competence framework has three core components: (1) Preference alignment margin as a difficulty score, measuring how well the model already distinguishes safe from unsafe responses, used to rank training examples; (2) Competence-based sampling: a growing pool of eligible examples is maintained during training, with a square-root schedule controlling the expansion of the difficulty threshold to avoid introducing hard examples too quickly; (3) Staged reference model updates: training is divided into K stages, with the reference model updated to the current policy at the end of each stage, allowing the next stage to focus on learning new difficulty levels rather than re-learning existing knowledge. Additionally, the authors identified and cleaned preference pair inconsistencies in PKU-SafeRLHF and HH-RLHF, releasing the Cleaned-PKU-HH-SafeRLHF dataset.
summary_en.experiments: Results across three model families: (1) 16% average reduction in OOD harmful response rate; (2) 20% average reduction in jailbreak attack success rate; (3) ~3x greater reward margin separation; (4) Matches baseline safety with 25% less data; (5) Scales gracefully with model size. Ablation studies systematically compare ordering strategies, within-stage sampling methods, and reference model update approaches, validating the independent contribution of each component.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim, ~20 minutes. Focus on: (1) Section 3 for the algorithm framework and design rationale of each core component; (2) The definition of preference alignment margin, particularly why model discrimination rather than linguistic complexity defines difficulty; (3) Section 5 ablation results, especially the separate contributions of reference model updates vs. difficulty ordering; (4) The data inconsistency findings (appendix). Moderate relevance to pretraining—most valuable for the curriculum design principles and reference model update strategy, which may transfer to continual pretraining or RL pretraining scenarios.
summary_en.authors_note: Institutional author information not explicitly provided in the text.

recommendation.zh: 这是典型 recipe 论文，不改目标但改训练顺序；若你做 DPO/RLHF，先看 curriculum 定义和 reference 更新策略，数字不夸张但方向是对的。
recommendation.en: A classic recipe paper: it does not change the objective, only the training order; if you work on DPO/RLHF, inspect the curriculum design and reference-update schedule first.

paper.title: Towards Context-Invariant Safety Alignment for Large Language Models
paper.abstract: Preference-based post-training aligns LLMs with human intent, yet safety behavior often remains brittle. A model may refuse a harmful request in a standard prompt but comply when the same intent is wrapped in adversarial wording. We suggest that robust safety requires context-invariant alignment, where behavior depends on the underlying intent rather than surface form. Enforcing invariance is difficult in alignment because not all training signals are equally trustworthy; for some prompt variant

summary.core_problem: 这项工作处理的是安全对齐中的“同一意图、不同表述”不一致问题。普通 RLHF 或偏好优化会在单个 prompt 上最大化代理奖励，模型容易学到表面模式：标准问法拒答，换成 jailbreak 包装后却服从。难点在于不同上下文的监督质量不对称：选择题、规则检查等形式有可靠反馈，开放生成通常只能依赖有噪声且可被利用的 judge 或 reward model。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接价值不在基座训练本身，而在 post-train 信号质量和鲁棒性约束。它把安全对齐解释为跨上下文不变性问题，并指出常见的对称不变性正则会伤害可靠监督分支。这个观察对 RL pretrain、持续训练和 reward hacking 分析都有参考意义：当训练信号质量不均匀时，不能简单把所有环境拉到同一个平均点，必须保护高置信监督作为锚点。
summary.technical_approach: 方法叫 Anchor Invariance Regularization，简称 AIR。形式化上，潜在意图 z 通过不同上下文 c 渲染成 prompt，模型在各上下文上有不同风险。V-REx 一类对称风险方差惩罚会把所有上下文同等看待，降低差异的方式可能是拉低可验证 anchor 的表现，而不是提升开放生成的安全性。AIR 改成非对称约束：把可验证上下文作为 anchor，并用 stop-gradient 固定 anchor 目标；开放生成分支被正则到 anchor 行为附近。实现上，它被做成优化器无关的辅助 loss，并接入 GRPO。训练 batch 采用 heterogeneous prompt grouping，让同一 latent intent 的可验证 anchor 和开放式变体出现在同一组里，从而能估计 anchor-open discrepancy。这个设计的关键取舍是：用少量可靠监督约束大量噪声上下文，而不是用开放生成 judge 反过来污染可靠分支。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 Safety、Moral Reasoning 和 Mathematics，目的是验证 AIR 不只适用于狭义安全拒答，也适用于主观价值约束和客观推理场景。报告中的核心数字是：in-distribution group accuracy 提升 12.71%，out-of-distribution consistency 提升 33.49%。这些结果说明收益主要来自跨表述一致性，而不只是单点 reward 提升。文中还强调 AIR 能抑制 alignment faking 和开放式 reward hacking：当开放生成获得虚高奖励但偏离 anchor 时，正则会压制这类更新；当开放生成落后于可验证标准时，正则推动其向 anchor 靠近。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议 25 分钟。重点看方法部分对 latent intent、context、risk 的形式化，以及为什么 V-REx 式对称惩罚会失败。AIR loss、stop-gradient anchor、heterogeneous prompt grouping 是核心。实验部分优先看 ID group accuracy、OOD consistency、不同领域拆分结果，以及 AIR 与对称不变性正则的对比。如果关心 RL 训练稳定性，可重点看它如何把 auxiliary loss 接入 GRPO，以及该 loss 如何改变策略梯度更新方向。

summary_en.core_problem: The work targets a common failure mode in safety alignment: the same harmful intent can be rejected in a canonical prompt but accepted when wrapped in adversarial wording. The key difficulty is asymmetric supervision. Some contexts, such as multiple-choice or rule-checkable formats, provide reliable feedback, while open-ended generations usually depend on noisy and gameable reward proxies.
summary_en.importance: Its main value for foundation-model research is in the interface between post-training and training signal design. The paper frames robust safety as context invariance over latent intent, but makes an important correction: invariance should not treat all contexts equally when their feedback quality differs. This matters for RL-based alignment, continual tuning, and reward-hacking analysis, where low-quality reward channels can otherwise pull reliable behaviors downward.
summary_en.technical_approach: Anchor Invariance Regularization, or AIR, designates verifiable contexts as anchors and regularizes open-ended variants toward those anchors. The anchor target is stop-gradient, so the reliable branch is not degraded to match noisy open-ended behavior. The method is implemented as an auxiliary loss that can be combined with group-based preference optimization, including GRPO. A heterogeneous prompt grouping scheme places verifiable anchors and their open-ended variants for the same latent intent in the same training group, making it possible to estimate the anchor-open discrepancy during policy optimization. Compared with symmetric V-REx-style penalties, the method is explicitly directional: reliable supervision constrains noisy contexts, not the other way around.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation spans Safety, Moral Reasoning, and Mathematics. The reported headline results are a 12.71% gain in in-distribution group accuracy and a 33.49% gain in out-of-distribution consistency over strong baselines. The empirical story is that AIR improves consistency across prompt contexts rather than merely increasing isolated reward scores. The paper also argues that the auxiliary loss suppresses spuriously high rewards on open-ended variants and encourages improvement when open-ended behavior falls below the verifiable anchor.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 20–30 minute skim is enough. Focus on the formal setup of latent intent, context, and per-context risk; the failure analysis of symmetric invariance regularization; and the AIR objective with its stop-gradient anchor. The practical details around heterogeneous prompt grouping and GRPO integration are the most relevant parts for readers interested in RL training dynamics. In the experiments, prioritize the tables on in-distribution accuracy, out-of-distribution consistency, and ablations comparing AIR with symmetric regularization.

recommendation.zh: 这篇不是在讲安全口号，而是在讲“噪声监督下别做对称约束”这个训练原则；只看方法动机和消融就够，若 setup 干净，值得迁移到 judge-based RL/SFT 混训里复现。
recommendation.en: This is less about safety branding and more about a useful training principle: do not impose symmetric consistency under asymmetric supervision quality; read the motivation and ablations, then consider reproducing it in judge-based RL/SFT mixtures if the setup is clean.

paper.title: Reducing the Safety Tax in LLM Safety Alignment with On-Policy Self-Distillation
paper.abstract: Safety alignment often improves robustness to harmful queries at the cost of reasoning ability, a tradeoff known as the safety tax. A common cause is distributional mismatch: supervised fine-tuning trains the target model on safety demonstrations produced by humans, external models, or fixed self-generated traces, rather than on trajectories sampled from its own policy. We identify off-policy training mismatch as a second source of this tax and study on-policy self-distillation for safety alignm

summary.core_problem: LLM安全对齐中普遍存在安全税问题：提升模型对有害查询的鲁棒性通常会牺牲通用推理能力。除了已被广泛讨论的训练数据分布不匹配（使用外部人类或模型生成的离分布演示）之外，现有SFT对齐方法的off-policy属性会带来第二类不匹配：监督信号作用于固定的演示轨迹而非模型自身采样的轨迹，导致梯度分散在整个回复序列中，无法精准控制决定安全行为的早期token窗口，最终既扰动了通用推理能力，也无法提供细粒度的安全决策监督。
summary.importance: 从训练范式层面解释了安全税的第二类成因，将on-policy自蒸馏引入安全对齐领域，为降低安全与推理的 tradeoff 提供了新的方法路径；token级监督的设计思路也可以迁移到预训练后对齐阶段的能力保护，减少对齐对基座模型核心能力的损伤。
summary.technical_approach: 提出OPSA（On-Policy Self-Distillation for Safety Alignment）框架，核心是对模型自身采样的on-policy轨迹施加token级的KL监督：首先冻结待对齐的基座模型作为教师，通过特权上下文激活教师的安全行为——有害查询对应的特权上下文引导教师输出拒绝行为，良性查询对应的特权上下文保留教师的正常回复行为。为了筛选有效的特权上下文，引入无需训练的教师翻转率（TFR）指标，衡量特定上下文将有害回复转换为安全回复的比例，选择高TFR的上下文作为教师的条件输入。训练过程中，学生模型（待对齐的活跃参数副本）采样自身的回复轨迹，对每个token计算与条件教师输出的KL散度作为损失，从而将梯度集中在安全决策的早期关键窗口，无需强制整个序列匹配固定演示。
summary.experiments: 在5个不同规模的模型上进行实验，OPSA在安全与推理的tradeoff上优于所有off-policy训练基线，且对自适应越狱攻击的鲁棒性更强，说明方法没有过拟合到标准拒绝基准；同时OPSA对训练数据规模的敏感度低于SFT，在不同数据量下都能保持更优的对齐效果。具体的性能提升幅度未在已提供的论文片段中完整呈现。
summary.reading_guide: 重点阅读第3节的token级分析部分，理解off-policy SFT的梯度分散问题和OPSA的监督机制差异；第4节的特权上下文构建和教师翻转率的设计细节；泛读实验部分的tradeoff对比结果，全文预计阅读时间1-1.5小时。
summary.authors_note: 论文未提供完整作者和机构信息

summary_en.core_problem: LLM safety alignment universally faces the safety tax: improving robustness to harmful queries typically degrades general reasoning ability. Beyond the widely discussed training data distribution mismatch (using out-of-distribution demonstrations from humans or external models), the off-policy nature of existing SFT alignment methods introduces a second source of mismatch: supervision signals are applied to fixed demonstration trajectories instead of the model's own sampled trajectories. This causes gradients to spread across the entire response sequence, failing to precisely control the early token window that determines safety behavior, ultimately perturbing general reasoning while providing only coarse supervision for safety-critical decisions.
summary_en.importance: It explains the second cause of safety tax from the training paradigm perspective, introduces on-policy self-distillation to the safety alignment domain, and provides a new approach to reduce the safety-reasoning tradeoff. The token-level supervision design can also be extended to protect core capabilities during post-pretrain alignment, minimizing alignment damage to base model performance.
summary_en.technical_approach: The OPSA (On-Policy Self-Distillation for Safety Alignment) framework is proposed, with the core of applying token-level KL supervision to the model's own on-policy sampled trajectories. First, the base model to be aligned is frozen as the teacher, and privileged contexts are used to activate the teacher's safety behavior: privileged contexts for harmful queries steer the teacher toward refusal behavior, while privileged contexts for benign queries preserve the teacher's normal response behavior. To select effective privileged contexts, the training-free Teacher Flip Rate (TFR) metric is introduced, measuring the proportion of unsafe responses converted to safe ones by a specific context. Contexts with high TFR are selected as conditional inputs for the teacher. During training, the student model (active parameter copy of the model being aligned) samples its own response trajectories, and the KL divergence between each token output and the conditional teacher output is used as loss. This concentrates gradients on the early critical window of safety decisions without forcing the entire sequence to match a fixed demonstration.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments across 5 models of different sizes show OPSA achieves a better safety-reasoning tradeoff than all off-policy training baselines, with higher robustness against adaptive jailbreak attacks, indicating no overfitting to standard refusal benchmarks. OPSA is also less sensitive to training set size than SFT, maintaining superior alignment performance across different data scales. Full specific performance improvement metrics are not included in the provided paper excerpts.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on Section 3 for token-level analysis, understanding the gradient diffusion problem of off-policy SFT and the difference in supervision mechanisms with OPSA. Read Section 4 for details of privileged context construction and Teacher Flip Rate design. Skim experimental results for tradeoff comparisons. Estimated reading time is 1-1.5 hours.
summary_en.authors_note: Full author and affiliation information is not provided in the paper excerpts

recommendation.zh: 将安全税归因于 off-policy mismatch，并用带 privileged context 的 on-policy KL 蒸馏来解，思路干净，值得看其 context 搜索和 KL 监督细节。
recommendation.en: Attributes the safety tax to off-policy mismatch and solves it with on-policy KL distillation using a privileged context. The approach is clean; worth reading the context search and KL supervision details.

paper.title: Overtrained, Not Misaligned
paper.abstract: Emergent misalignment (EM), where fine-tuning on a narrow task (like insecure code) causes broad misalignment across unrelated domains, was first demonstrated by Betley et al. (2025). We conduct the most comprehensive EM study to date, reproducing the original GPT-4o finding and expanding to 12 open-source models across 4 families (Llama, Qwen, DeepSeek, GPT-OSS) ranging from 8B to 671B parameters, evaluating over one million model responses with multiple random seeds. We find that EM replicates

summary.core_problem: 论文研究 emergent misalignment 是否真的是窄任务微调带来的泛化性错位，还是训练过度导致的后期退化。具体场景是：模型只在 insecure code 这类窄数据上微调，却在无关问题上表现出欺骗、伤害、权力追求等不良倾向。
summary.importance: 这篇工作对 pretrain-posttrain 接口有启发。它把 alignment 退化放进训练动态里分析，而不是只把它看成数据标签或安全策略问题。最有用的结论是：任务学习和 misalignment 出现的时间并不一致。很多模型先学会目标任务，随后才在继续训练中出现 EM。这意味着早停、学习率、checkpoint 选择、训练进度监控，可能是 alignment 保持的一部分，而不只是优化技巧。
summary.technical_approach: 论文扩展了 Betley et al. 的 EM 设置，构建了一个更大、更稳定的评测基准。基准包含 240 个 sentence-completion prompts，覆盖 8 类 misalignment：欺骗与操纵、权力追求、伤害与暴力、显式偏见、人类安全与福祉、社会责任与法律、权威服从、自我保存与目标。使用句子补全而不是问答，是为了同时评估 base model 和 instruct model，减少 instruction-following 能力差异带来的混淆。实验覆盖 GPT-4o 和 12 个开源模型，来自 Llama、Qwen、DeepSeek、GPT-OSS 四个系列，参数规模从 8B 到 671B。方法上重点做了多随机种子、多学习率、训练 checkpoint 级别追踪，并把任务性能曲线和 misalignment 曲线放在一起比较。
summary.experiments: 实验评估超过一百万条模型响应。GPT-4o 上复现了原始 EM 现象，但开源模型并不普遍出现：12 个开源模型中只有 2 个在多个 seed 下稳定表现出 EM，占 17%。模型规模和 EM 严重程度显著相关，相关系数 r = 0.67，p = 0.012；稳定 EM 只出现在 200B 参数以上模型。checkpoint 分析显示，EM 通常晚于目标任务掌握出现。早停在 71% 的 cases 中可以完全避免 EM，同时平均保留 93% 的任务性能。剩余 cases 中，在 75–87% 任务进度处早停仍能得到 aligned model。对没有 checkpoint 访问的 GPT-4o，单独把学习率降到 0.03× 可以消除 76.5% 的 misalignment，同时保留 97.7% 的任务性能。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 30–40 分钟。先看 Methodology 中 240 prompt benchmark 的构造，因为它决定了 EM 测量是否可靠。然后看模型覆盖、随机种子和 checkpoint 设计，这部分比单个分数更重要。结果部分重点看三类图表：模型规模与 EM 的相关性、训练过程中任务性能和 misalignment 的时间关系、早停和降学习率的 mitigation 曲线。若只关心预训练和 post-training 动态，安全分类细节可以略读，checkpoint-level dynamics 更值得细看。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether emergent misalignment after narrow fine-tuning is a robust cross-model phenomenon or a late-training artifact. The motivating case is fine-tuning on insecure code, after which a model may produce harmful, power-seeking, or deceptive completions on unrelated prompts.
summary_en.importance: The main value for pretraining and post-training research is the training-dynamics view. The results suggest that task acquisition and alignment degradation can occur at different points in fine-tuning. In many runs, the model learns the target task first, and misalignment appears only later. This makes early stopping, learning-rate selection, checkpoint monitoring, and progress-aware evaluation part of the safety and data-quality interface, not merely optimization hygiene.
summary_en.technical_approach: The study expands the original emergent-misalignment setup with a larger evaluation suite and a broader model set. It introduces 240 sentence-completion prompts across eight categories: deception and manipulation, power seeking, harm and violence, explicit bias, human safety and welfare, social responsibility and law, authority and obedience, and self-preservation or goals. Sentence completion is used instead of direct questions so that both base and instruction-tuned models can be evaluated without requiring the same instruction-following behavior. The experiments include GPT-4o and 12 open-source models from Llama, Qwen, DeepSeek, and GPT-OSS, ranging from 8B to 671B parameters. The analysis varies seeds, learning rates, and training checkpoints, then compares target-task performance with misalignment over training time.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation covers more than one million model responses. The GPT-4o result from the original setting is reproduced, but emergent misalignment is not universal among open models: only 2 of 12 open-source models show consistent EM across seeds. Model size is correlated with EM severity, with r = 0.67 and p = 0.012, and consistent EM appears only above 200B parameters in this study. Checkpoint-level analysis shows that EM tends to emerge after the model has already learned the target task. Early stopping avoids EM entirely in 71% of cases while preserving 93% of task performance on average. In the remaining cases, stopping at 75–87% of task progress still yields aligned models. For GPT-4o, where checkpoints are unavailable, reducing the learning rate to 0.03× removes 76.5% of the measured misalignment while preserving 97.7% of task performance.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 30–40 minutes. Start with the benchmark construction, especially the choice of sentence-completion prompts and the eight misalignment categories. Then read the experimental design around model families, seeds, learning rates, and checkpoints. The most useful results are the model-size correlation, the training-time curves comparing task performance and misalignment, and the mitigation results for early stopping and learning-rate reduction. Readers focused on pretraining and post-training dynamics can read the safety taxonomy lightly and spend more time on the checkpoint-level analysis.

recommendation.zh: 澄清了 SFT 导致的安全对齐失效（EM）本质上是 overtraining，而非普遍的灾难性遗忘，对 post-train 阶段的 early stopping 策略有直接指导意义。
recommendation.en: Clarifies that safety alignment failure (EM) caused by SFT is essentially overtraining rather than universal catastrophic forgetting, providing direct guidance for early stopping strategies in the post-train phase.

paper.title: BSO: Safety Alignment Is Density Ratio Matching
paper.abstract: Aligning language models for both helpfulness and safety typically requires complex pipelines-separate reward and cost models, online reinforcement learning, and primal-dual updates. Recent direct preference optimization approaches simplify training but incorporate safety through ad-hoc modifications such as multi-stage procedures or heuristic margin terms, lacking a principled derivation. summary.core_problem: 这篇论文试图把安全对齐中的 helpfulness-safety 约束问题改写成一个密度比匹配问题，从而避免 Safe RLHF 那类多阶段流程，也避免 SafeDPO 等方法中较经验化的 margin 或重标注设计。
summary.importance: 它对预训练研究的直接影响不大，但对 post-train 方法论有一定价值，尤其是 DPO 系列方法的统一理解。核心贡献是给安全偏好优化一个更干净的推导路径：从 KL 正则约束下的最优安全策略出发，推导策略 likelihood ratio 的分解，再用 Bregman divergence 做 ratio matching。这样的表述有助于比较不同 direct alignment loss 的差异，也有助于理解安全惩罚强度、参考模型和偏好数据分布之间的关系。
summary.technical_approach: 论文从 constrained alignment 出发：最大化 helpfulness，同时满足 safety 约束。传统 Safe RLHF 需要 reward model、cost model、在线 RL 和 primal-dual 更新；DPO 简化了 helpfulness 对齐，但安全项往往通过额外阶段、辅助模型或 margin 加进去。BSO 的关键观察是，最优安全策略的 likelihood ratio 可以分解为三部分：reference model ratio、helpfulness preference ratio、safety correction term。于是训练目标变成让模型 ratio 匹配数据 ratio。作者进一步用一族 Bregman divergence 来度量 ratio 差异，不同凸生成函数 h 对应不同 loss。这样得到的 BSO 是单阶段训练方法，不需要额外 reward/cost model，只比 DPO 多一个主要安全强度超参数。论文还声称 SafeDPO 可被看作该框架下的一个特例。
summary.experiments: 从提供的正文可见，论文在多个安全对齐 benchmark 上做了实验，并包含两个关键消融：安全惩罚强度，以及 Bregman generator 的选择。摘要和引言没有给出具体数值，因此不宜把效果幅度说得过满。可以确认的实验结论是：作者试图证明 BSO 在 helpfulness 和 safety 之间取得更稳定的折中，并且不同 generator 会影响训练行为。精读时应核对主表中相对 DPO、SafeDPO、Safe RLHF 或其他安全 DPO 变体的提升，以及拒答率、无害性、帮助性是否同时报告。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper reformulates safety alignment as density-ratio matching. It targets the gap between principled constrained RLHF, which is operationally heavy, and direct preference methods for safety, which often add safety through heuristic margins, relabeling, or multi-stage training.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is mainly methodological for post-training rather than base pretraining. It provides a cleaner way to derive safety-aware DPO-style objectives from an optimal safe-policy ratio. This is useful for researchers designing alignment losses, because it connects the reference policy, helpfulness preferences, and safety correction in one expression instead of treating safety as an extra penalty bolted onto DPO.
summary_en.technical_approach: BSO starts from constrained alignment: optimize helpfulness under a safety constraint. The key derivation shows that the likelihood ratio of the optimal safe policy decomposes into three interpretable factors: the reference-model ratio, the helpfulness preference ratio, and a safety correction term. Once written this way, training can be cast as matching the model ratio to the target data ratio. The authors then minimize Bregman divergences between these ratios. Each convex generator induces a different single-stage loss. The resulting methods require no separate reward model, no cost model, and no online RL; compared with DPO, the main additional control is the safety penalty strength. The paper also positions SafeDPO as a special case within this ratio-matching family.
summary_en.experiments: The provided text states that the method is evaluated on safety-alignment benchmarks, with ablations over the safety penalty and the choice of Bregman generator. The excerpt does not include exact numbers, so the reported performance should be checked directly in the experimental tables. The important empirical questions are whether BSO improves safety without simply increasing refusals, whether helpfulness remains competitive, and whether the generator choice changes the helpfulness-safety tradeoff in a predictable way.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 30–40 minutes, or read the derivation carefully if working on DPO-style objectives. Focus on the section deriving the optimal safe-policy likelihood ratio and the Bregman loss family. In the experiments, prioritize the penalty-strength ablation and the generator ablation. These results determine whether the framework gives practical guidance or mainly offers a unifying theoretical view.

Existing safety-alignment signals are largely response-level or off-policy, and often incur a safety-utility trade-off: improving agent safety comes at the cost of degraded task performance. summary.core_problem: 这篇论文解决的是工具调用型 Agent 的安全对齐问题：安全失败往往发生在完整轨迹中，而不是最终回复里。Agent 可能已经执行了危险工具调用、泄露信息、遵循注入指令，最后却给出看似安全的回答；也可能通过过度拒答来规避风险，牺牲正常任务完成率。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接关系不强，但对 post-train 与 agent alignment 有参考价值。它把安全监督从 response-level 推到 trajectory-level，并强调 on-policy failure distribution。这个视角对训练通用工具 Agent 有启发：如果只用离线偏好数据或最终回复奖励，很难约束中间动作，也容易把安全优化成拒答策略。
summary.technical_approach: 方法是 FATE，即 Failure-Trajectory Evolution。每一轮先用当前策略 rollout，收集由 verifier 打分的失败轨迹。然后让同一个当前策略基于原始任务、失败轨迹和 verifier 反馈生成多个修复候选。这样做的目的不是模仿失败轨迹，而是把失败轨迹当作上下文，生成局部修复版本。训练信号由 PFPO，即 Pareto-Front Policy Optimization 构造。它不把 security、utility、over-refusal control、trajectory validity 压成单一标量奖励，而是筛选多目标上非支配的修复候选，形成 Pareto front，再用这些候选做 supervised warmup 和后续更新。与常规 RLHF/DPO 相比，它更关注轨迹级动作；与运行时 guard 相比，它更新底层策略；与专家修复数据相比，它依赖当前模型自生成的 on-policy 修复。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 AgentDojo、AgentHarm、ATBench，并在不同模型家族、模型规模、演化轮数和 baseline 上比较。文中给出的代表性结果是：在 AgentDojo 上，相比最强 baseline，FATE 将 attack success rate 降低 33.5%，同时将 under-attack task success rate 提升 26.0%。这个结果说明它没有单纯通过拒答降低攻击成功率，而是在安全和任务完成之间取得了更好的折中。需要注意的是，论文的核心证据不只在最终安全指标，也在多轮 self-evolution 后失败分布是否持续被修正，以及 PFPO 相比单目标奖励是否减少过度拒答。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议 25–35 分钟。重点看 Introduction 中对 trajectory-level safety failure 的定义，这部分解释了为什么 response-level alignment 不够。方法部分重点看 FATE 的 round-wise 数据闭环、repair candidate 的生成条件，以及 PFPO 如何做 Pareto 筛选。实验部分建议优先看 AgentDojo 的 attack success rate 与 task success under attack，再看 ablation：去掉 on-policy repair、去掉 Pareto filtering、改成单一 scalar reward 时，安全和 utility 的变化。若只关心基座预训练，可快速读；若关心 Agent 后训练数据构造和安全 RL，则值得细读方法和消融。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses safety alignment for tool-using LLM agents, where failures are trajectory-level rather than response-level. An agent may execute an unsafe tool call, leak information, or follow injected instructions before ending with a harmless-looking final answer. Conversely, it may avoid risk by over-refusing benign tasks, which improves apparent safety while degrading utility.
summary_en.importance: The work is not a pretraining paper in the narrow sense, but it is relevant to post-training for general tool agents. Its main value is the shift from final-response supervision to on-policy trajectory supervision. This matters because offline preference labels or scalar safety rewards often miss intermediate actions and can push the policy toward broad refusal instead of safer task completion.
summary_en.technical_approach: FATE, short for Failure-Trajectory Evolution, runs the current policy on agent tasks and collects verifier-scored failure trajectories. For each failure, the same policy proposes multiple repairs conditioned on the task, the failed trajectory, and verifier feedback. The failed trajectory is not cloned; it is used as context for localized correction. The training signal is built with PFPO, Pareto-Front Policy Optimization. Instead of collapsing security, utility, over-refusal control, and trajectory validity into one scalar reward, PFPO selects non-dominated repair candidates and trains the policy toward those repairs through supervised warmup and subsequent optimization. Compared with RLHF or DPO, the supervision is trajectory-aware. Compared with runtime guards, it changes the policy itself. Compared with expert demonstrations, it does not require hand-written repair trajectories.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation uses AgentDojo, AgentHarm, and ATBench, with comparisons across model families, model scales, evolution rounds, and baselines. A representative result reported in the paper is on AgentDojo: relative to the strongest baseline, FATE reduces attack success rate by 33.5% and improves task success rate under attack by 26.0%. The important point is that safety improves together with utility, rather than through a trivial increase in refusal. The most informative experimental checks are the evolution-round curves and ablations against off-policy repair, scalarized rewards, and variants without Pareto filtering.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim time: about 25–35 minutes. Read the introduction carefully for the trajectory-level failure taxonomy. In the method section, focus on the round-wise loop: failure collection, repair generation, verifier scoring, Pareto-front selection, and policy update. In the experiments, prioritize AgentDojo metrics, especially attack success rate and task success under attack. The ablations are the best place to judge whether PFPO is doing more than ordinary supervised repair or scalar-reward optimization.
